name: TIP WIZARD Spray Calculator
description:
Simply input an agricultural spray or liquid application, and Tip Wizard will sort through and provide you the best Combo-Jet spray tips for the job. It will both simplify your tip selection process, but if you are wanting to become a better spray applicator, it provides advanced tools to give you more depth to look into.

It provides industry leading information for rate controlled spray systems as well as Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) Sprayer Systems like Capstan PinPoint™, Case AimCommand®, John Deere ExactApply®, Raven Hawkeye® and more.

Simply, by entering your intended spray volume, speed, spacing, etc, Tip Wizard will be able let you tailor it specifically to your actual (real-life) spraying conditions.

For example, Tip Wizard charts provide a % of total volume that would be considered driftable fines (%<141µ), so you could estimate off-target spray volume in ideal conditions.

Tip Wizard also provides the % of total volume <600µ, resulting in a relative factor of spray coverage (or % of small droplets which would lend themselves well to coverage spraying).

The two pieces of information (%<141µ and %<600µ) can make a much clearer decision and inspire confidence of knowing how a spray tip would operate in ideal conditions, before you even buy them.

Chemical efficacy and environmental due diligence both hinge on being able to make qualified application decisions, so Tip Wizard gives the most information as to plan an application for success.

Pulse Width Modulation technology, which is becoming more prevalent for agricultural spraying, is also included within Tip Wizard's searches, making it once again easier to pick spray tips dedicated for that system. It shows the effective PWM duty cycles at any speed, allowing much easier decisions to be made with tip size on a PWM sprayer.

Some newer features to Tip Wizard are the ability to select fertilizer streamer nozzle and visual flow indicator metering orifices within the app itself.

Another new function to Tip Wizard is being able to select which style/type/size and ball to use with Flow View Ball Flow Indicators. (Another agricultural liquid application: liquid fertilizer or chemicals applied in furrow with seed)

Wilger is committed to develop and produce high quality liquid application components that meet or exceed our customers' needs, broadening their success and ours.

Through information, education, and innovation we ensure Wilger products are being used in setting best practices in an ever-changing environment.

Use the timer like a punch clock, then review totals like a time card calculator when it is time to check hours, overtime, billable work or project costs.

Android tools for faster tracking

Your data, your choice
No WorkingHours account or registration is required for the app itself. Optional sync uses your own cloud storage, including OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud or WebDAV, so you can keep your work log available across supported Android, Windows, iOS and macOS versions.

That means you can track time on your phone or tablet, then continue reviewing or editing your timesheet on a laptop or desktop through the app's sync model.

Free to use, optional Pro
WorkingHours is free to use. Some advanced features require WorkingHours Pro, which can be tested with a 7-day trial after installing the app.

On Android, Pro removes ads and includes advanced features such as cloud sync, Excel/CSV export, focus sessions, unlimited tasks, widget and notification timer control, and geofencing. Pro is available as either a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription with the same features.

Your Android Pro purchase or subscription is linked to your Google Play account and unlocks Pro for the Android version. Other platforms may require a separate purchase.

No problem! You can still track your time through the app, and once you're back online, it will sync with your account (and the rest of your devices) - your time (and money!) is not going anywhere.

You betcha (and we'd love to hear from you)! You can send us feedback directly from the app - look for the 'Submit Feedback' in the Settings menu.

On the server side, DriverLog provides the dispatcher with complete visibility of the status of every driver in the HOS shift and cycle including replay of daily history and comprehensive reports.

To meet different customer requirements and specific system configurations to send data from the ECM to the ELD and then to upload and synchronize the ELD with the server, Driver Log is packaged with multiple hardware solutions that plug into the vehicle ECM and sends the J1939 and J1708 protocols to the ELD via Bluetooth or WIFI, learn more by clicking this link http://www.wlius.com/hos

• Allows editing logs (while recording the edit)

• Fully integrated with DVIR.
• Automatic driving and stop status detection.
• Automatically uploads to the server via cellular or WIFI every event in real time, so the dispatcher has a complete real time visibility of the drivers’ status within the HOS shift and cycle.
• No data can be lost – the data on the Android device synchronizes real time with the server and is being backed up on the server. In case that the Android device is broken or lost, the driver’s data is downloaded from the server automatically to the new Android device.
• The identical logs displayed on the driver’s Android device are also displayed and printable on the management console.
• DriverLog is fully integrated with Wireless Links Fleet.Net GPS based fleet management system or if you already have a fleet management system DriverLog can be an independent standalone system.
• For integrators DriverLog can be fully integrated into any 3rd party fleet management and/or dispatch application.

name: Truck Weight Calculator
description:
Truck Weight Calculator helps you slide tandems, estimate axle weights, and stay legal—fast.
Using a platform and cat scale has never been easier. You can offset scale readings and weighing in or out of the scale.

Sliding trailer axles to the right hole eliminates guesswork and saves time and money on re-weighing. You can specify your load arrangement and weight distribution to make axle slide calculations more precise.
This helps ensure compliance at truck weigh stations, reduces the risk of overweight fines, and gives you peace of mind before rolling in. Think of it as your backup plan—built to keep you safe, legal, and confident on the road.

If you're overweight on an axle, the app helps you fix it—when possible. That might mean sliding axles to the right hole, burning off excess fuel before reaching the weigh station, adjusting the fifth wheel, or simply knowing your state’s weight regulations.

Estimating axle weight is a premium feature that lets you calculate axle weights before you even reach the scale. The app uses the gross weight of the load (payload) from your Bill of Lading and your load arrangement to make accurate predictions. It’s useful in all kinds of everyday trucking scenarios.

If there’s no scale nearby, you can set your axles in the hole with the highest chance of being compliant—no guessing required. You’ll get a calculated solution that gives you peace of mind, especially when hauling lighter loads and unsure if scaling is necessary. The estimator helps you analyze different scenarios and pick the safest hole.
Plus, you can spot load arrangement issues ahead of time—while you're still being loaded.

Whether you're hauling pallets or equipment, Truck Weight Calculator helps you stay legal, save time, and optimize your load. Core features are free, and premium tools are available via in-app purchase.

Truck Weight Calculator supports 53' (16m) and 48' (14.6m) trailers (cooler, dry-van, flatbed) with 2–3 axles and axle splits up to 11'6". While designed for palletized loads, it can also provide rough estimates for equipment on flatbeds—making it a versatile truck axle weight calculator for real-world scenarios.

Built for drivers, by those who understand the road. Whether you're scaling, planning, or adjusting on the fly, Truck Weight Calculator keeps you compliant, confident, and moving forward.

Features:

Bridge Scale Axle Calculation – Instantly compute steering, drive, and trailer weights as you roll over bridge scales

Set your load settings (general HAZMAT, water pollutants, explosives) and navigate on eligible and safe roads only. Set preferences such as right turns, avoidance of toll roads & ferries, or arrival with the destination on the right side.

Never get lost waiting for a signal again. Offline maps guarantee you'll always find anything you need – even without an internet connection. They come in handy when driving abroad or in areas with poor signal coverage. We update the map data multiple times per year.

Add Realtime traffic to avoid delays on the road, have precise ETA information, and deliver on time. Speed cameras warn you when a mobile or fixed speed cameras are on your route. Head-Up display (HUD) projects optimized navigation instructions onto the car's windshield.

Navigate to thousands of reliable and detailed points of interest (POIs) from trusted sources, such as truck stops, weight stations, parking lots, campsites, hotels, restaurants, etc. Fill up at the best price with realtime information about fuel prices along your route.

6. Truck & caravan specific Speed limits & alerts
The sat nav app shows the current speed, the maximum allowed speed, and upcoming speed limit changes. You will get clear visual and sound alerts when you exceed the speed limit.

7. Dynamic lane assistant & Clear voice instruction
The sat nav app will guide you into the correct lane and show you the junction with highlighted lanes and exits. Voice navigation with clear & accurate driving instructions helps focus on the road ahead and frees you from checking the route on a phone display.

8. Multistop route planning & Optimization
Plan your trip and set up routes with up to 150 waypoints. Easily customize the waypoint order or choose the option "Optimize." The app will rearrange the waypoints to achieve the best efficiency.

9. Plan with Google Maps & send the route to the app (Android only)
With Sygic Truck Route Sender – a cost-free extension available in Chrome and Firefox - you can plan your route with Google Maps with up to 10 stops on your desktop. Then send the route directly to the app.

Job Flexibility at Your Fingertips

Ready to shine bright and make your future spark? Whether you’re looking for per diem, short-term, long-term, or permanent work in the medical field, ShiftMed puts incredible power at your fingertips, letting you choose the shifts that fit your style, all while earning those dollar bills with a smile.

Through our app, you can easily access a variety of open shifts at various healthcare facilities in your community, from long-term care locations to nursing homes to hospitals. When building your work schedule precisely how you want it, our app has all the tools you need to succeed.

You can filter your shift feed based on your preferred start time, driving distance, hourly rate, and favorite healthcare facility. Talk about personalized perfection! We also don’t believe in shift minimums—work 8 hours one week and 40 the next. And unless you’re looking to make some sweet holiday pay, mandatory holidays, overtime, and weekends are no longer a thing.

Work Benefits You Deserve

As a ShiftMed nurse, you can access benefits that will make your heart sing and your career soar. We’ve got an entire lineup of perks that include competitive pay, holiday rates, bonus incentives, affordable healthcare plans, and exclusive in-app features.

· Guaranteed Shifts®: Get paid for the entire shift if the facility cancels or sends you home early. So, there’s no need to stack your schedule with overlapping shifts because you’re worried a facility might cancel—the only shift you need to claim is a guaranteed one.

· ShiftMed Instant Pay™: Request up to 75% of your pre-taxes earnings immediately after clocking out of a shift. Submit the desired amount, and we’ll deposit the funds directly into your bank account with ZERO transaction fees.

· Platinum Rewards Program: We reward you big time for showing up for shifts, from entry into monthly sweepstakes to first dibs on holiday pay rates. And the higher your show rate, the better your shift-claiming experience gets.

· W-2 Employment Status: When you work with ShiftMed, you’re a W-2 employee—not a 1099 independent contractor. Being a W-2 employee is loaded with benefits, such as paying less in FICA payroll taxes, being eligible for company benefits, and so much more!

Connect With Us

name: TimerDash: Multi Timer Alarm
description:
I built TimerDash because I wanted a timer I could trust: one I could set, then reboot my phone and leave it locked until the alarm fires. I also needed stopwatches that ran accurately for months or longer. Timing should stay correct through timezone and daylight saving changes. And none of it should come with the usual baggage — no accounts, no ads, no subscriptions, and no tracking. The app uses the internet only for a one-time lifetime purchase through Google Play billing.

The free version of TimerDash gives you a limited number of timers and stopwatches for casual use. The pro version is a one-time lifetime purchase that unlocks everything and includes all future app updates and improvements.

Use TimerDash for study sessions, workouts, meditation, cooking, Pomodoro sessions, or anything else that needs reliable timing.

Here's the full description:

*Run Multi Timers & Stopwatches*
Manage multiple countdown timers and stopwatches. Name and color-code each one. Control them individually or start and stop everything at once. Reorder with up/down buttons, or tap the favorite button to pin one to the top of the list.

*Alarms & Notifications That Don't Miss*
Alarms ring loudly even when the app is closed. Fade-in alarms use audio focus to cut through music. Full-screen alerts appear on the lock screen, including right after your device restarts — no unlock required!

*Long-Running Laps & Intervals*
Record laps and intervals that persist after device restarts. Stopwatches can run accurately for years. Track long-term habits and projects that can span months. Fastest and slowest laps are highlighted automatically. One-tap copy sends your lap list to the clipboard (Pro).

*Switch Modes in One Tap*
TimerDash has different modes and you can switch between them with one tap: Timer ↔ Stopwatch and Single ↔ Multi. Set timer duration with dials or type an exact time. Use +30s and −30s buttons to quickly adjust a running or paused timer. In Single timer mode, tap Repeat on completion to make it a one-tap repeat timer for meditation.

*Customize Alarms and Vibration*
Choose a default alarm sound for all timers, or set a different sound for each one. Set alarm volume, timeout, and fade durations to suit your preferences. Toggle vibration, and choose whether alarms respect your device's Do Not Disturb setting.

*Stay Informed at a Glance*
Timers show start time (in Single mode), ETA, and duration. Ongoing notifications show all scheduled timers with time remaining and ETA, so you can check progress without opening the app. Overtime display shows how long it's been since a timer finished. Visual alerts let you know when alarms are disabled or permissions are missing.

*Buy Once, Use Forever*
Upgrade to Pro to unlock 12 Multi timers + 12 Multi stopwatches, copy laps to clipboard, and save up to 50 timer presets. Pro includes all future app updates and improvements. Free version includes one Single mode timer/stopwatch, one Multi mode timer/stopwatch, 2 timer presets, and 10 stopwatch laps.

name: Planit Pro: Photo Planner
description:
Please email info@planitphoto.com for bug reports or feature requests. Please also remember to visit https://youtu.be/JFpSi1u0-is for more video tutorials. Each video only lasts a few minutes but you will sure learn a lot from them. You can also reach us through Instagram or Facebook. Links are under the menu inside the app.

This is a special call to landscape photographers, travel photographers, nature photographers and those who are interested in night photography, city photography, time-lapse, star-trails, milky way or astro-photography: look no more, this is the ultimate app for you - the Planit Pro. It only costs you a cup of Frappuccino but will save you tons of time and effort and a lot of gas money. Most importantly, it will make you enjoying landscape photography even more.

Ansel Adams dedicates the beginning of his first book "Taos Pueblo" to visualization. He introduced the idea of "previsualization", which involved the photographer imagining what he wanted his final print to look like before he even took the shot. Of course, there are many great photos which were taken impromptu. However, for landscape photographers, being able to previsualize the scene before going there will greatly reduce the chance of being caught unprepared and will greatly increase the chance of getting better shots.

Photographers use various tools to help them pre-visualizing the scene. Nowadays, many of those tools are phone apps. Planit Pro is an all-in-one solution that is designed to leverage the map and simulated viewfinder technologies to provide the necessary tools for photographers to pre-visualize the scene in combination with the ground subjects and the celestial objects such as the Sun, the Moon, Stars, Star-trails and Milky Way.

In the Planit Pro app, we packed it with features - from location scouting such as GPS coordinates, elevations, distance, elevation gain, clear view, focal length, depth of field (DoF), hyperfocal distance, panorama and aerial photography, to the Ephemeris features such as the sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset time and direction, twilight time, special hours of the day, sun/moon finder, major stars, constellations, nebulae azimuth and elevation angle, star trail planning, time-lapse calculation and simulation, sequence calculation and simulation, milky way searching, solar eclipse and lunar eclipse, exposure/ND filter calculator, light meter, rainbow position prediction, tide height and tide search etc. All the information are either represented on the map as an overlay or visually presented in simulated viewfinders (VR, AR, picture, or street view), just like you look through your camera's viewfinder. Whatever you want for your landscape photography, it is there in the Planit Pro.

Landscape photography is an adventure in the nature world. We understand sometimes there won't be any network connection when you are out exploring. Planit Pro was designed for have it in mind. If you preload the offline elevation files and the offline mbtiles maps, you can use the app fully offline without the need for network connections.

description:

THIS IS THE AD-FREE VERSION OF PHOTOGRAPHER'S COMPANION WITH MORE FEATURES.

This application will help you to abandon the automatic mode of your cameras that doesn't do everything and control everything. For more experienced photographers, it can simplify the settings by doing the calculations for you (/!\ Camera adjustment must be done manually). It includes more than 40 tools and will also allow you to plan your photo outings from home by locating the places and positions of the Sun, the Moon or the Milky Way.

It is aimed at professional or amateur photographers (basic knowledge is required) and offers the tools to:
- Calculate the alternative/equivalent exposure (manages the ND filter and long exposures)
- Calculate the depth of field, hyperfocal and simulation of Bokeh
- Calculate the field of view
- Calculate the shutter speed to freeze the motion of a subject
- Capture/Photograph sunrise/sunset, the golden hour and the blue hour
- Get the position of the sun, time of sunrise/sunset, golden hours, blue hours and monthly calendar
- Capture/Photograph the moon based on the phase of the day
- Capture/Photograph moonlit landscapes
- Capture/Photograph lunar eclipse
- Get the position of the moon, the hour of moonrise/moonset and the monthly calendar
- Capture/Photograph the stars, the milky way without or with star trails (Simulator)
- Capture/Photograph the northern lights
- Capture/Photograph the lightning and the fireworks
- Calculate the best setting for an EV (exposure value) given
- Calculate distance or aperture with a flash
- Calculate the optimum settings according to the lighting of the place (Light Meter), the reflectance (albedo) of the subject and measure light color temperature
- Calculate for the macro photo the possible magnification with a close-up lens or an extension tube
- Calculate the print size
- Time lapse
- Planner for landscape photos, from a drone and panorama

- Calculate the reciprocity failure
- Bracketing
- Tilt lens

- Tools

name: Golden Hour: Retro Film Camera
description:
Turn your phone into a real film camera. Golden Hour is a vintage camera app that brings back the soul of analog photography — authentic film grain, dreamy light leaks, warm tones, and that one-of-a-kind golden hour glow that only film can capture.

Shoot every moment like it's the last frame on the roll. No edits needed. No filters that feel fake. Just real, beautiful film photos — straight from the shutter.

✨ AUTHENTIC FILM LOOK
Every shot is processed through a real film simulation engine that recreates the grain, tones, and color science of classic 35mm film stocks. Not a preset slapped on top — a true film camera experience built from the ground up.

📸 RETRO & VINTAGE CAMERAS
Choose from a curated collection of retro cameras — disposable camera, 35mm film camera, instant camera, CCD digital camera, and more. Each camera has its own personality, color palette, and character. Switch between them with one tap.

🎞 REAL FILM GRAIN & TEXTURES
Film grain isn't a Gaussian blur on top of your photo. It's stochastic texture mapped to your sensor data, giving you the same beautiful imperfection you'd get from a real film roll. Plus dust, scratches, and halation for that fully analog camera feel.

🌅 GOLDEN HOUR LIGHTING
A signature Golden Hour mode tuned for warm, cinematic light — perfect for portraits, sunsets, street photography, and travel shots. Every photo looks like it was taken at magic hour.

💡 LIGHT LEAKS & LENS FLARES
Hand-crafted light leaks, lens flares, and color bleed effects that mimic the imperfections of vintage film cameras. Subtle, beautiful, never overdone.

🖼 POLAROID FRAMES & INSTANT CAMERA LOOK
Built-in polaroid camera frames and instant camera styles. Print-ready square crops with classic white borders, perfect for sharing on Instagram, scrapbooking, or printing as keepsakes.

📅 VINTAGE DATE STAMPS
Add classic film date stamps in the bottom corner — just like the old disposable cameras and family albums. Multiple date stamp fonts and styles available.

🎨 PROFESSIONAL FILM PRESETS
A library of carefully tuned film presets inspired by classic film stocks. Warm, cool, faded, high-contrast, pastel — find your signature look in seconds. Save your own custom presets too.

📱 SHOOT, DON'T EDIT
Golden Hour applies the film look in real time as you shoot — what you see is exactly what you get. No long export waits, no post-processing required. Capture and share instantly.

🌍 SHARE EVERYWHERE
One-tap share to Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, Snapchat, and more. Photos save to your gallery in full resolution so you can print them, frame them, or upload them anywhere.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE GOLDEN HOUR

• Real-time film effects — no waiting for renders
• Multiple retro camera styles to fit every mood
• Designed for both photographers and casual creators
• No watermarks on your photos
• Lightweight, fast, and easy to use
• Built with love by a small indie team

PERFECT FOR

📷 Film photography lovers who miss the look of analog
🎨 Creators who want their feed to stand out with a vintage aesthetic
👫 Friends capturing memories that feel timeless
✈ Travelers shooting golden hour landscapes and street scenes
💍 Couples and families building photo albums with character
🌆 Anyone tired of phone photos that look too clean and digital

JOIN THE FILM REVIVAL

Film photography is back. Golden Hour brings the soul of analog cameras — the warmth, the grain, the imperfect beauty — to your phone, without the cost of buying real film or developing rolls. Every shot tells a story. Every photo feels like a memory.

Download Golden Hour now and start shooting your life on film.

---

We read every review. If you have feedback, ideas, or want to see a specific film stock or retro camera added — leave a review or contact us in-app. We ship updates often based on what you tell us.

Happy shooting. ✨🎞📸

description:
Solight – Your Essential Guide to Golden and Blue Hour

Solight is the ultimate app for photographers, filmmakers, travelers, and light lovers who want to make the most of the day’s most magical moments: the golden hour and the blue hour.

Whether you're capturing a perfect sunrise photo, planning a romantic evening walk, or simply enjoying nature in its best light, Solight helps you track the most beautiful light phases of the day — anywhere, anytime.

🌅 What are the Golden and Blue Hours?

Golden Hour: The warm, soft light shortly after sunrise and before sunset.

Blue Hour: The cooler, deep blue light that occurs just before sunrise and just after sunset.

These short periods are perfect for photography, videography, or just taking in the beauty of natural light.

✔️ Precise Golden and Blue Hour Times
Get accurate start and end times for golden and blue hours based on your location.

✔️ Change Location with Ease
Traveling? Planning ahead? Solight lets you change your location to any city in the world to check light phases there.

✔️ Pick Any Date and Time
Explore past or future days to plan the perfect photo shoot, event, or outdoor experience.

✔️ Beautiful, Intuitive Interface
Visualize the day with a clean, modern timeline that makes it easy to see how the light changes.

✔️ Animated Sky Backgrounds
Enjoy a relaxing animated sky that reflects the time of day, with soft gradients and passing clouds.

✔️ Explore the Whole Day
Swipe through the hours to see how daylight evolves from night to golden hour, to midday, to blue hour and back to night.

📍 Why Solight?

Solight is not just a tool — it's an experience. It helps you stay in sync with natural light and plan your moments around it. Whether you're a pro photographer chasing the perfect shot or just someone who enjoys a peaceful sunrise, Solight is made for you.

name: Shot Designer
description:
Shot Designer is a ground-breaking tool for Directors and DPs that creates Animated Camera Diagrams, with integrated Shot List, Storyboards, Professional Director's Viewfinder, and Sync & Team Sharing via the Hollywood Camera Work cloud at no extra cost.

WHAT IS SHOT DESIGNER?

• CAMERA DIAGRAM - Shot Designer dramatically speeds up the Director's process of making camera diagrams. Create full-blown diagrams in minutes. The software does most of the work.
• ANIMATION - Animate your characters and cameras to move around your diagram in real-time. Previsualize the rhythm of a scene by seeing it play out.
• SHOT LIST - The integrated Shot List is tied into the diagram and writes itself while you work. Edit shots intuitively in the diagram, not in a confusing spreadsheet.
• DIRECTOR'S VIEWFINDER / STORYBOARDS - Bring in lens-accurate camera angles via the integrated Director's Viewfinder or Storyboard Import.
• MAC/PC DESKTOP VERSION - An identical Mac/PC Desktop Version is included with the Pro Version (in-app upgrade).
• SYNC & TEAM SHARING VIA DROPBOX - Sync your scenes across all your devices. Share scene folders with teams. Control who owns which scene. (Pro Feature)

Watch the feature-demo at http://www.hollywoodcamerawork.com/shot-designer-videos.html

CAMERA-BLOCKING ON STEROIDS

Shot Designer was developed by Per Holmes, the creator of the Hollywood Camera Work training.

Shot Designer is based on the realization that neither Camera Diagrams, Shot Lists, or Storyboards by themselves give you a satisfying understanding of camera-blocking -- you have to use them *together*.

Shot Designer is FAST. The app knows how Directing works and automatically does most of the work for you. Cameras rearrange themselves when you move characters. Animate characters and cameras with simple Walk To and Track To commands. Create sophisticated tracking shots with multiple marks. Shot Designer is fast enough that you can rearrange the diagram with actors waiting.

OTHER FEATURES

• Integrated Set Designer for building floor plans.
• Integrated Lighting Designer for DPs, with lighting symbols provided by Ari Golan of Atomic Imaging Studios Chicago.
• Import production drawings as backgrounds and block on top of them.
• Factory Templates of pre-made camera setups for any situation.
• Make your own templates as starting points for new scenes.
• Large and growing prop/furniture library. Email us requests, we'll build them.
• Scene Freeze: Experiment easily by taking snapshots you can return to (Pro).
• PDF/JPG/Excel export and emailing of Camera Diagrams and Shot Lists (Pro).
• Unlimited Folder Structure for organizing scenes (Pro).

The Free Version of Shot Designer is full-featured except for Save and Export. Your current scene is always saved, and you can be fully productive working on one scene at a time. The Pro Version (in-app upgrade) adds File Management, identical Mac/PC Desktop Version, PDF/JPG/Excel Export, Scene Freeze and more.

To save space, the initial app download contains just piano — you can then manage which of the bundled Soundsets to have on your device or keep in the cloud, just tap on Sound Installation.

Notion has been featured in various worldwide campaigns and has won several awards, including a prestigious music industry NAMM TEC Award for Best Smartphone/Tablet App.

Fender Notion includes unlimited staves, comprehensive editing features and core orchestral and rhythm section Soundsets — all for free. name: Sonofield Ear Trainer
description:
Sonofield Ear Trainer (SET) is a revolutionary ear training app designed to help you intuitively play the melodies you hear and imagine. Instead of relying on traditional methods like intervals, SET focuses on helping you feel the unique character of each note within a key. By using sustained drones to create a tonal foundation, you’ll learn to recognize scale degrees based on their *feeling*, not just how they sound.

The app offers a variety of ways to train:
* Degrees Mode - Identify individual notes against the drone by feeling. The heart of SET.
* Melody Mode - Identify short melodic phrases, preparing you for real music.
* Voice Mode - Sing the requested scale degree into your microphone.
* Pocket Mode - Hands-free training for when you're on the go.
* Free Play - An interactive instrument for exploration.

With its intuitive, color-coded interface, thoughtfully designed progression path, and multiple difficulty levels, SET adapts to your skill level while keeping practice engaging. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced musician, SET is your guide to unlocking true musical fluency through intuitive, feeling-based ear training.

No ads or forced payments. The free version contains full foundations for feeling-based ear training. Download the ear training app now!

name: ABC Trainerize
description:
ABC Trainerize is an online personal training platform that empowers fitness professionals and studios to better connect to their clients when training them online or in-person.

By combining both a trainer and a client-side experience, ABC Trainerize allows fitness professionals to stay connected with their clients and manage their coaching business from their smartphones anytime, anywhere.

At the same time, ABC Trainerize helps individuals achieve their fitness goals by keeping them engaged with their coach. Trainers help clients stay committed to their program through customized and comprehensive training plans and progress reports.


WHO CAN USE THE APP:
ABC Trainerize is for both fitness professionals and their clients. A fitness professional needs to create an account before they can invite their clients to access the app. Clients can only use ABC Trainerize is they are working with a fitness professional or business that uses ABC Trainerize.


FEATURES FOR FITNESS PROFESSIONALS:
- Customize and deliver training plans with live or on-demand workouts, classes, and exercises.
- Manage client calendars, check-ins, and current workouts.
- Offer meal plans, recipes, and nutrition coaching within the app.
- Create and plan client workouts on the fly.
- Monitor and track client progress seamlessly.
- Instantly message clients in real-time and set up client groups and challenges.
- Extend your business and services by connecting with add-ons like Glofox, Mindbody, Zapier, and YouTube.


FEATURES FOR CLIENTS:
- Access and follow online training plans, tracking your workouts seamlessly.
- Easily track your food intake with the built-in food calorie tracker.
- Plan your daily meals and discover new recipes.
- Engage in real-time messaging with your coach and take part in groups and challenges.
- Keep tabs on body stats and monitor progress in one place.
- Work towards your health and fitness goals and stay motivated through streaks and app badges.
- Receive app reminders for scheduled workouts and activities.
- Seamlessly integrate with apps, wearables and smart devices (Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, Withings, Garmin etc.) to sync daily stats such as steps, sleep, activity, weight and heart rate.


IMPORTANT NOTE: This app is a companion app for businesses that use ABC Trainerize. An online account is required. If you're a client, ask your trainer for your account details so you can login to this app. For more information visit our website.

name: Gravl: Personal Trainer
description:
Build muscle, increase your strength, or get lean with Gravl. Whether you are at home in the gym or outside, Gravls training algorithm will provide you with a personalized workout designed to help you reach your fitness goals.

A new generation of fitness algorithm

Unlike existing fitness apps, Gravls Algorithm doesn't just assemble random workouts. Our technology looks at your unique attributes (gender, weight, age, training level) and studies your workout patterns to evolve around your schedule, goals, equipment, and place of training.

As you train more Gravl gets better. Your training plan will maximize your progress by adjusting intensity, volume, and weight for each session. The outcome is a balanced effective workout every time.

Optimal exercises

Not all exercises are created equal and Gravl knows this. We believe that mastering the most effective exercises is more important than having different exercises every time. We balance optimal movements and variation so that your exercises are diverse and challenging.

For beginners, or seasoned gym-goers looking for new workouts, we have over 300 trainer-led videos so you can always add new movements with confidence.

Track your progress

Gravls Strength Score makes measuring your strength and progress straightforward. We calculate this based on 8 different subscores and millions of data points across people of your same age gender body weight and fitness experience.

Customization

You can let Gravl lead the way 100% or set up your own custom workout settings. You have the power to change your fitness goal, workout variety level, muscle split, duration, equipment, and more!

Coach Support

Get support from our coaches, whether you need tips to make the most of our app or workout advice, just message us in-app at any time.

name: Personal Trainer - Gym Log
description:
Personal Trainer is a complete gym companion that works entirely offline. Your workout data stays on your device, always available.

Free to use. One-off payment to unlock everything (friends, sharing, etc). No subscriptions!

BUILD CUSTOM TRAINING PLANS
Create weekly training plans tailored to your routine. Pick your training days, name them (Chest Day, Leg Day, Pull Day), and fill each day with exercises from a library of movements. Each exercise comes with muscle targeting data, form guides, and suggested loads based on your body weight and experience level.

TRACK EVERY SET
Log weight, reps, and difficulty for every set during your workout. Or quick-log a set straight from any exercise page — no need to start a full session. A built-in rest timer with an audible bell keeps you on pace between sets. Personal records are detected automatically — you'll know the moment you hit a new max.

EXERCISE LIBRARY
Browse exercises by muscle group, movement pattern, or equipment type. Create your own custom movements for machines, cables, or bodyweight skills not in the built-in catalog. Each exercise includes:
• Primary and secondary muscle targets with efficiency percentages
• Form descriptions and technique guidance
• One-tap YouTube video search to watch proper form demonstrations
• Load recommendations for novice, intermediate, and expert levels
• Alternative exercises for the same muscle groups

TRAIN WITH FRIENDS
Add friends with a simple friend code and see how your training stacks up on a shared leaderboard. Compare Total lifted, Total sets, or Active days over the past week, month, or year. Friends are optional and you can hide your stats anytime — the rest of the app works fully on its own.

DAILY CHALLENGE
Not sure what to train today? Spin the Daily Challenge wheel on the Home screen and let the app pick a random movement from your available equipment.

SMART PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD
After every set, the app suggests your next weight based on how the last set felt. Too easy? It recommends a bump. Too hard? It dials it back. All suggestions rounded to standard plate increments.

MONITOR YOUR PROGRESS
• Workout history with volume, sets, and tonnage per session
• Personal records tracker (max weight and max reps)
• Weekly progress charts
• 72-hour muscle recovery tracker across 14 muscle groups
• Plan-aware streaks — rest days in your plan don't break your streak
• Achievement system with 6 tiers from First Workout to Legend
• Muscle Museum — see which body parts you've been training and spot gaps

WORKS OFFLINE. SYNCS WHEN READY.
Your data is stored locally. When you're connected, cloud sync backs up your data and keeps it in sync across devices automatically.

DESIGNED FOR THE GYM
• Dark theme optimized for low-light gym environments
• Fast set logging — get in, log, get back to lifting
• Haptic feedback on interactions
• Customizable rest timer (15 seconds to 10 minutes)
• Weekly training digest every Sunday

PRIVACY FIRST
• All data stored locally on your device
• Google Sign-In for identity only — no server-side account
• Cloud sync & Health Connect are optional and encrypted in transit
• No ads. No tracking. No data sold.

VIP PREMIUM — PAY ONCE, UNLOCK FOREVER
The free Standard tier includes the full workout experience: track unlimited sets, the movement library, smart weight suggestions, cloud sync, achievements, and the past 7 days on every chart and history view.
Upgrade to VIP Premium with a single in-app purchase (no subscription!) to unlock:
• Unlimited workout plans (Standard keeps 1)

name: Baby: Breastfeeding Tracker
description:
This App is a handy and reliable assistant for breastfeeding your newborn baby. You can track breastfeeding, bottle feeding, solid feedings and milk pumping. You can save diaper changes, sleeping periods and the results of your baby's height and weight measurements. This baby tracker app will help parents get through the wonder weeks.

With this breastfeeding tracker you can:

✔️ Track feeding by one breast or by both, if you give your baby two breasts at one feeding
✔️ Track bottle feeding
✔️ Measure solid food feeding - food type and amount
✔️ If you need to pump your milk, measure how many ml/oz of each breast were expressed with a pump log
✔️ Tracking diaper changes, you can note whether it is wet or dirty, or both :)
✔️ You’ll always know how many diapers were changed per day
✔️ Record baths, temperatures, walks, and medications
✔️ Handy breastfeeding timer and sleep timer are easy to stop and to restart
✔️ Your baby's height and weight can be measured almost daily! They are also easily stored in the baby diary.
✔️ You can add a reminder for each event - periodic and easy-to-set
✔️ Displays baby nursing and sleeping timers in the notification bar, so you have easy access to the App
✔️ Logging and tracking activity of multiple babies. Supports twins!

Being a FTM (first-time mom), or new mom, in general, is very tiring and challenging! You got through pregnancy, you’ve probably just made it home from the hospital, are totally exhausted, and a little overwhelmed by your new responsibilities. The first few months of your baby’s life mostly revolves around a schedule of eating, sleeping, diaper changes and occasional little doctor’s visits.

It’s not always easy to remember the last time you fed your baby or changed their nappy. It’s very helpful to monitor everything and get a quick glance to remind you the last time you did it, or the next time you have to. It will definitely give you a peace of mind and make your day that much easier to have a log to check whenever needed.

It’s extremely important to track when you had your last feeding session, but also track the weight and how long they were eating to make sure they’re eating properly and gaining weight at a normal rate.

Also, keeping track of diapers is very imperative to keeping your baby healthy. All moms definitely need an easy way to check how often they’re changing diapers. Not to mention, you should definitely track if everything looks normal during diaper changes.

For some parents, it’s very important to track every ounce of food and it’s imperative they have a baby feeding tracker. Some babies, unfortunately, have minor illnesses after coming home from the hospital. Keeping track of all this information will help your baby on the road to recovery and healthy growth much more easily.

As a new mom, don’t forget to take care of yourself as well. The first few weeks will be tiring! There will definitely be times you fall asleep on the couch suddenly, and everyone needs some help or handy reminders. Alarms and graphs are a great way to have an at-a-glance look at what you need to do without stressing over “what if I forget?”.

Just click the appropriate button to begin feeding, or other activities. Your baby care history will be reliably stored. All this information may be useful when you visit the pediatrician, as well as for the further development of your child.

Feed baby easily and quickly. This breastfeeding app helps you track everything and enjoy motherhood.

Care Circle Management:
Invite siblings and anyone else involved in caregiving (including paid caregivers) to use the app (free of charge to those you invite). Create a one-stop hub of key info for everyone (meds, doctor lists, health documents like insurance cards). Coordinate care, add members to certain events, and create group chats or direct messages.

A list of your Loved One’s medication at your (and the Care Circle’s) fingertips. Create automated medication reminders for your Loved One, stay on top of doses & refills, and even be alerted to potentially dangerous interactions between medications.

Upload images of key documents like insurance cards, medical records (test results, appointment notes) and more — all with HIPAA compliance so you can use the app safely and securely.

Track events like doctor’s appointments, family meals, gatherings your Loved One plans to attend, and more — using a calendar within the app that’s dedicated to your Loved One’s care.

Manual Health Vital Tracking (or upgrade to automatic tracking):
Use the app to manually log your Loved One’s vitals so you can see trends over time. Cell-enabled remote vitals tracking devices are available for just $5/month extra per device (also requires one-time device purchase). Options include: Blood Pressure Monitor; Digital Weight Scale; Pulse Oximeter (to measure Blood Oxygen); Glucometer.

Custom Notifications:
Set your preferred notification sequence — push notification, text, or email — and stay up to date with the most important information.

SAFETY+ | $45/month
Visit myconnectedcaregiver.com/safety to sign-up.

Get EVERYTHING from Care Essentials, plus greater peace of mind with real-time emergency alerts and fall detection through the discreet and trusted Rely-X device (FREE for a limited time — a $119 value).

Senior Medical Alerts:
With the press of a button, your Loved One can instantly alert you and our 24/7 monitoring team to get the help they need. Our Monitoring Center caters to more than 1.3M subscribers with 3 monitoring locations to ensure no communication drops. The average call response time is just 9-seconds after the button is pressed.

Fall Detection for Seniors:
Programmed to detect falls and immediately call for help, giving you peace of mind when you can’t be with them. If a fall is detected, our agents will call the Loved One via the 2-way cell enabled Rely-X device and send emergency help if needed. As the caregiver you can also choose to be notified. See a history of recorded falls within the app.

GPS Location & Geofencing:
GPS monitoring and nationwide 4G cellular coverage ensures you’ll always know where your Loved One is located. You can even set up geofencing to be notified if your Loved One exits or enters a certain location.

First Motion & Step Tracking:
Monitor your Loved One’s first motion each day to ensure they’re moving around as expected — and see their step count to gauge how active they are.

To learn more, visit myconnectedcaregiver.com

name: Elderly Care: health + protect
description:
This senior app improves a loved ones physical and mental health and well-being by helping them:
* to be more socially connected and more active (raises happiness and well-being)
* to maintain independence (help family and caregivers to remotely monitor and support them)
* to manage health and self-care (automatic popup medicine reminders…)
* to feel safe and protected (panic button, GPS tracking, motion sensor…)

This health app makes it easier for a family and caregivers to care for and get closer to their senior loved ones.

This senior care app allows people to create a closed private care group: people in the group are securely connected and are able to share and see whats happening.

How it can help you:

[1] Senior health app
This senior health app helps a person establish and maintain daily mental and physical health routines. Features sensors, daily recurring tasks and reminders to help a person improve their ability to self-care.

[2] Senior safety app & Panic button
This senior safety app uses phone/tablet sensors and home IoT sensors to monitor and detect problems. It alerts family and caregivers in the care-group. Great for senior safety. A Panic button (SOS app) works 24/7 indoors and outdoors. The GPS tracker with geo-fencing can tell you when a loved one leaves home and when they arrive back.

[3] Daily senior living
This senior citizen app allows a senior to be socially engaged, contribute to family or community, continue with activities that give life meaning, and to maintain choice and control. Automatic sensor notifications help a person to feel connected and involved with their family.

[4] Senior care app
A remote family member can receive an automatic notification telling them what time their loved one woke up (which is nice and reassuring), and more notifications throughout the day: what time they took their medicine; if they went outside for a walk, and what time a caregiver went to visit them, etc.. The app has special large icons that make it easier for a person to express the care needs and feelings.

[5] Dementia and Alzheimer’s app
If a loved one suffers from a decline in memory or confusion, perhaps Alzheimer’s disease, dementia or Parkinson’s disease, then this senior app can support daily living. You can setup tasks remotely, add notes and add photos, it will then pop-up as a notification on your loved ones phone. Great for independent living.

[6] Elderly phone app
This elderly phone app has background sensors that run 24/7 and lets family and caregivers see how much the phone/tablet device is being used and whether the battery is being kept charged,…

[7] Elderly launcher app
This elderly launcher app has large buttons for making phone calls, opening favorite websites, and clicking favorite places for Sat-Nav. So no fiddly keyboard typing. A great feature of this senior launcher app is that it can be setup remotely by family and caregivers.

[8] Caregivers app
This caregivers app helps organize care visits and enables remote caregivers to monitor and support the health & well-being of seniors with a wide range of care needs and frailty: motion sensors can monitor people with mobility and fall safety concerns; automatic care-plan popup reminders help people maintain their health and independence,…

PRIVACY
This senior citizen app works by consent - each person can chose what features to switch on and share.

SUMMARY - This senior app is designed to promote senior safety, senior health, and senior living. The app features built-in phone sensors, external home IoT sensors (due October 2021), GPS tracking and automatic geo-fence location alerts, and advanced daily recurring tasks and reminders to protect and monitor the health of an elderly person. It’s great for someone who is active and independent, and also for those with health issues, such as frailty, Alzheimer’s or Dementia, and need additional support and care. And its a senior launcher app with large buttons for phone calls and websites.

Fall Alert
If the phone user was to either has a fall or a sudden jerk while driving, the phone will send out a message to you. This settings sensitivity can be modified based on the phone user’s lifestyle.

Geo-fence Zone Alert
Receive alerts when the device leaves or enters a pre-configured geo-fence area, such as a neighborhood, a town or metropolitan area. Geo-fence alerts are sent out to your email with the current location of the device.

Inactivity Tracker
For seniors who live alone, this is a very important feature to let others know if they have been immobile for an extended amount of time. You can configure the time in hours based on the person's lifestyle. Receive alerts to your email.

Low Battery Alert
Phone is often the only contact with the outside world for many seniors, hence, keeping it charged is of utmost importance. Configure when you want to get alerts based on battery availability.

App Usage Report & Alerts
Review a list of apps that are in use on the phone with the time spent on each, receive an alert whenever a new app is installed or an existing app removed. Malicious apps have become commonplace with some that are specifically targeted to seniors.

Emergency Medical Information
Often details like doctors name, phone, medications, allergies, and other pertinent medical information remain unavailable during emergencies. Senior Safety App ensures all this and more is available at your fingertips if an emergency was to occur.

SHARED DOCUMENT VAULT FOR ELDERLY PARENT RECORDS

SHARED FAMILY UPDATES WITHOUT THE UPDATE TEXTS

FREE TO START
Essentials for care coordination are available without blocking the basics behind a paywall. When you need more, subscriptions unlock extra capacity like a larger care circle, more loved one profiles, expanded document storage, health trend charts, and longer care log history.

PRIVACY & TRUST
No ads in the app — we’re supported by optional Premium subscriptions, not banner ads. Your family’s information matters; review our Privacy Policy in the app or on our website.

Caregiver supports care coordination; it does not replace professional medical advice. Always follow your health professional’s guidance.

name: FanClaws dog walkers & sitters
description:
FanClaws is an app for pet owners who need to look after their pets and for pet lovers who would like to earn money doing what they love.
If you need to go on holiday or a business trip and cannot leave your pet with anyone, if you are at work all day and your pet is bored at home alone or has no one to take it out - pet care is available any day and at any time via the app.
The app offers the following services:
• 24-hour pet sitting at the sitter's property if your pet is friendly and doesn't mind changing places, and at the owner's property if your four-legged friend is stressed about moving and new places;
• hourly pet sitting at the sitter's property - drop your pet off at the sitter before you leave for work and don't worry about it being bored while you're away, and take it home after work;
• hourly visits to the owner's property to look after your pet - if your four-legged friend is quite independent and tolerates loneliness, the sitter can visit for a few hours to feed and clean it or take it for a walk;
• dog walking - if your dog requires a walking schedule that you can't keep because you're busy, walkers will be happy to walk your dog as many times as it needs at the required time.
SITTER IN THE NEIGHBOURHOOD
One-click selection of sitters that are closest to you. They will be able to look after your pet when it's convenient for you. A handy map with the exact location of sitters for better navigation.
TRUST AND SAFETY
The profiles of all sitters go through three steps of verification:
1. checking the phone number;
2. email verification;
3. identity check, which includes a verification of the authenticity of the identity document and a verification that the face from the photo and the identity document match.
HONEST REVIEWS
Only owners who have used the sitter can leave reviews for the sitter. This excludes the possibility of casual reviews.
EASY TO BOOK AND PAY
Find and book the most suitable sitter for you and your pet in a few clicks. Pay your orders securely in-app and online. If a sitter refuses to fulfil an order or performs poorly, we will refund your money.

name: Pet Pill Reminder & Tracker
description:
Pet Pill Reminder helps you keep every pet's medication routine organized, accurate, and easy to review.

It is built for pet owners who need more than a basic alarm. Track medications for dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, reptiles, and other pets, then log what was given, skipped, early, or late.

FEATURES:

- Medication reminders - Set daily, every-other-day, weekly, or custom schedules.
- Multi-pet support - Keep each pet's medications and records separate.
- Dose tracking - Record tablets, half tablets, syringes, drops, liquids, capsules, and more.
- Inventory tracking - Enter current supply and low-supply thresholds, then let logged doses update stock automatically.
- Low inventory alerts - See when a medication is running low before you miss a refill.
- Accurate dose history - Review scheduled time, given time, skipped doses, and late doses.
- Editable given times - Correct a logged time from the History screen.
- Early logging support - Log a dose up to one hour before the scheduled time.
- CSV and PDF export - Share medication records with your veterinarian or keep a backup.

- Dark mode - A calmer view for evening care routines.

PET CARE IS MESSY:

Real medication routines are not always exact. A dose may be given a little early. A morning medication may be added after starting the schedule in the evening. A bottle may run low sooner than expected. Pet Pill Reminder is designed around those real-world moments.

PREMIUM:

Pet Pill Reminder offers an optional one-time Premium unlock for ad removal, dark mode, export, and follow-up reminders. No subscription is required.

PRIVACY:

Your pet profiles and medication records are stored locally on your device. No account is required.

Made by MyQuietSpot Inc.

name: TOM Medication & Pill Reminder
description:
TOM is your cost-free, ad-free and anonymous, daily medication reminder with an integrated medicine list and log, that makes it easy for you to manage your medicine and allows you to enter measurements and record activities. The TOM medical alert app is a fully integrated medical assistant with a daily pill reminder.

With our medical alert app, you can add a new medicine to your virtual medication list in just seconds. Your medical assistant TOM does the rest for you. With our pill reminder app, you will forget about any registration, charge, and advertising!
User-friendly and completely anonymous: the integrated medicine reminder will notify you whenever it’s time to take your pills, tablets, and other meds, making your daily activities much simpler. Now for measurements and activities as well, including graphs and statistics showing everything at a glance.

Developed by patients, for patients
The TOM medication reminder with the integrated medicine list and medication log is so practical and user-friendly because its developers know from personal experience which requirements a digital medication tracker and scheduler need to meet. The pill reminder is the ideal solution for simply and efficiently managing treatment regimens for a wide range of conditions, including diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, Crohn’s disease, stroke, epilepsy, cardiovascular diseases, multiple sclerosis, and more.

Key features of the medical alert app at a glance
• Easy to use thanks to dialogue-based design: TOM asks and you reply – without filling in forms or having to tediously search through menus
• Add new meds, measurements, or activities quickly and easily
• Send or print PDFs of monthly health reports
• Medication log and medicine list with high-quality graphs and statistics for all pills taken, health measurements, and activities
• Feature for uploading your own pictures of med packaging
• Digital cabinet provides a complete medication list that can be printed out as a PDF file
• Pill reminder with alarm to refill prescriptions before they run out or expire
• Fully integrated treatment management that combines a record of meds you have taken with your health measurements (blood pressure and weight, for example) and activities (running, yoga, etc.)
• Keep your medication log up to date: pills are taken daily, medicine intervals of several days or hours, single doses or taken sporadically
• Suitable for managing the treatment of a wide range of conditions and diseases (cardiovascular disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, multiple sclerosis, stroke, asthma, etc.)
• Modern solution for managing medicine in order to ensure they are taken at the right time and to monitor the progress of your treatment
• Medication reminder if you forget to take your pills
• Maximum data security thanks to the anonymous use of the TOM pill reminder and two-way encryption

Privacy and data protection are top priority
Using the TOM medication tracker and scheduler is completely anonymous: no registration with personal details is required. The information you enter is linked only to a randomly generated ID number. Even TOM does not have access to this number, as it is also cryptographically protected. In addition, all communication with the TOM app is encrypted in both directions.

Download the TOM medication reminder on your smartphone and let the simple medication tracker and scheduler add some extra freedom to your daily life. Never forget to take your tablets, pills, or medicine again thanks to the pill reminder and medicine tracker. Suitable for a wide range of conditions, including high blood pressure, asthma, stroke, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, etc.

SUBMIT YOUR FEEDBACK TO HELP IMPROVE TOM
Thank you for using the TOM medical alert app. Your feedback helps us to further develop the TOM medication reminder and offer you maximum benefit. We always encourage you to send your suggestions and ideas to support@tommedications.com.

name: Pillbug: the fun meds reminder
description:
Pillbug is a helpful little bug obsessed with one thing: making sure you take your meds and supplements on time, and actually ENJOY taking care of your health. Whether you’re managing ADHD medication, antidepressants, birth control pills or anything else, Pillbug makes staying consistent simple, private, and rewarding.

Medications are a clinical issue, but we think medication apps should not FEEL clinical, they should be fun to use. That's where Pillbug comes in.

Reliable reminders you’ll actually respond to!
Pillbug keeps you on schedule with gentle, caring reminders.
He highly recommends installing his widget so you never forget a dose. That way he’ll even tuck you into bed when you’ve had a good medication day (he’s very proud of you!)

Say goodbye to “Wait… did I take it?”
We’ve all had that stressful moment: Did you take your medication today? Should you take it now? Did you maybe already take it? You don’t want to skip it. You don’t want to double-dose. What do you do?

Pillbug fixes that!
See, logging your meds is crucial to understanding your health, but most people forget to log, or they log first and get distracted before taking their dose. Then logs become unreliable.
Pillbug’s patent-pending Scan to Log feature changes everything. Just scan any label - your bottle, pillbox, right as you take your medication.
Because if you’re right next to your meds when you log them, you’ll actually take them.
And you can trust your log completely.
Pillbug will even warn you if you’re about to take the wrong pill. He’s responsible like that.
Optional, but once you try it, you’ll never understand how you managed without it.

Don’t worry you can still log through notifications or through the app if you forget to scan.

Shared medication management (optional)
With Pillbug, medication management becomes collaborative. Perfect for families with teens or young adults, or for partners supporting each other.
More effective management without the nagging.

Privacy first
Your health data stays securely on your device. It’s never uploaded, shared, or accessible to anyone - not even us.

Perfect for
• Students juggling classes, internships, and a busy life
• Young professionals with packed schedules
• Anyone who wants to take their meds reliably, safely, and playfully
• People who want a medication habit that finally sticks

Download Pillbug now
Build a routine you can trust.
Never forget a dose again.
And do it with a tiny friend cheering you on.

Medical Disclaimer
Pillbug does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your physician or qualified health provider with any questions about your medications or health conditions.

name: PMDD Symptom Tracker
description:
PMDD, tracked with the seriousness it deserves. Lunaire PMDD Tracker is a private, offline symptom diary built for people living with premenstrual dysphoric disorder. Log luteal-phase mood crashes, rage, anxiety, physical symptoms and cycle patterns — all stored only on your device. No accounts. No cloud. No tracking.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK
• Mood — low mood, rage, anxiety, hopelessness, irritability
• Sleep quality & insomnia
• Energy & fatigue levels
• Physical symptoms — bloating, breast tenderness, cramps, headaches
• Brain fog & concentration
• Food cravings & appetite shifts
• Cycle phase — follicular, ovulatory, luteal, menstrual
• Medication & supplement adherence — SSRIs, hormonal treatments and supplements
• Weight, BBT, exercise, food & drink

PRIVACY-FIRST BY DESIGN
PMDD data — especially mood logs — is deeply personal. It doesn't belong on someone else's server.
✓ Everything stays on your device
✓ No account, no sign-up, no email
✓ No cloud sync, no analytics, no ads
✓ Works fully offline
✓ You own the data — back it up or delete it in one tap

SEE YOUR LUTEAL PATTERN
PMDD is cyclical by definition — but the pattern only becomes visible with weeks of consistent tracking. Lunaire maps your mood and symptoms against your cycle phase, so the luteal drop, its duration, and the impact of treatment changes become visible from your first full cycle. A calendar view and cycle-phase markers come as standard; deeper 90-day trend analysis is part of Premium.

PDF REPORTS FOR YOUR DOCTOR OR PSYCHIATRIST
Generate a clean PDF summary of your cycle-mood pattern, symptom severity and medication history — share it with your doctor, gynaecologist or psychiatrist in one tap. Two months of tracked data is worth more than any ten-minute appointment recall.

BUILT FOR PMDD, NOT PMS
PMDD is not "bad PMS". Most period apps lump them together and miss the pattern entirely. Lunaire PMDD Tracker is built specifically for the DSM-5 symptom set — severe mood symptoms, functional impairment, luteal-only timing — with the language and tracking that actually reflect what PMDD is.

FREE FEATURES
• Unlimited symptom, mood and cycle logging
• 7-day history & trends
• Mood, sleep and physical symptom tracking
• Medication & supplement adherence
• Weight, BBT, food & exercise logs
• Calendar view with cycle phase
• Local-only storage

PREMIUM FEATURES
• Full 90-day history & trend analysis
• 90-day PDF reports for your clinician
• Data export as CSV
• Backup & restore (local JSON file)

Premium is a one-time purchase or an affordable monthly subscription. No free-trial traps. No auto-renewing surprises.

Built in the UK by Lunaire Labs. Privacy-first symptom trackers for cycle, perimenopause/menopause, PMDD, endometriosis, thyroid, IBS, fibromyalgia, POTS and lupus.

PMDD is real. Track it on your terms — privately, on your device.

Important: Lunaire PMDD Tracker is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. It is a personal symptom diary. Life Notes is an app that allows you to record your chronic symptoms and lifestyle habits on a daily basis in order to monitor them, but also to potentially highlight some correlations.

It's possible to create your own symptom list in order to score them day after day, rating thef pain level intensity on a scale from 0 to 5.

It's also possible to record your meals, medications and add various notes, as well as your sleep schedules to highlight the causes of your symptoms. For example, it is easier to highlight the link between some of your meals and your possible stomach aches.

In addition to noting the daily evolution of the symptoms at different times of the day, it's also possible to enter an overall level of pain intensity over the course of a day in order to have a broader view of their evolution.

In short, Life-Notes offers what a simple notebook could do for you, but with a focus on tracking symptoms and providing statistics.

None of your data is sent online, 100% of your data is stored on your phone's memory.

name: Pain Tracker & Diary
description:
This app helps you understand and precisely share what you feel daily and keeps track of what types of pain your treatments are helping.

WHY DID WE MAKE THIS?
You hurt. Your pain is chronic and complicated. You can’t remember everything. You want your doctors to understand, but you don’t know how to explain what you feel.

PAIN IS LIFE-CHANGING. HELP IS HERE.
Nanolume® developed the Pain Tracker & Diary to help you record the daily textures, intensities, and locations of what you feel, so you and your care team can better understand what you are suffering with and follow how your pain responds to medications and treatments.

TRACK IT BETTER. TREAT IT BETTER.
Pain is a complex experience. It often includes multiple pain types (layers), each with its own unique texture, intensity, location, and surface area.

By keeping a diary that integrates complex information, you can show your doctors what you are experiencing to help them make a better diagnosis, choose more appropriate medications and treatments, and monitor if your treatments are beneficial. In addition, by keeping such an integrated record, trends might emerge that would otherwise go unnoticed.

PAIN IS DIFFERENT.
Pain is a subjective (not objective) sensation that you cannot measure. Its assessment relies on each person’s ability to communicate what they feel. Nanolume® developed this digital diary to help you record what you feel every day.

INCLUDED FEATURES.
For each diary entry you create:
• Choose a Pain Type. Choose from a list of predefined pain types or create a customized pain type. Next, tap the icon of the pain type you feel is most intense (you can come back and add more types later).
• Select the Intensity. Select the intensity of your pain type using a Numeric Rating Scale (NRS).
• Draw an Outline. Use your finger to draw an “outline” of the type of pain you are experiencing on the front and back sides of a generalized map of your body.
• Calculated Surface Areas. The app displays the percent [%] of your body surface affected by each (or all) of the pain types you draw.
• Zoom. Need to see a larger image of your hand or foot? Double-tap: once to zoom x2; twice to zoom x4; a third time to restore the original size.
• Notes. Tap the “Notepad” icon located in the top-left corner of each opened diary entry to record any details of your medications or treatment results.
• Tap "Add Pain." Choose another pain type (layer) to draw.
• Save Your Diary Entry. Tap "Done" to create a snapshot of all the pain type layers you drew. The app attaches the date and time your entry was saved.
• Open a Saved Entry. Tap on the date and time of the entry you want to review. Look at the intensity, location, and surface area of each pain type you experienced (by touching the icon of the pain type you want to see) or see all the pain types at once and see how they overlap (tap the "All Layers" icon). Swipe the picture left or right to check how your other pain entries compare over time.
• Charts. View a summary of your data in "Charts."
• Forget to Save an Entry? Go back and recreate a "pain picture" from the past; then, use the "Calendar" icon to backdate the recreated entry.
• Calendar Backdating. Touch the "Calendar" icon to backdate any pain-picture you draw to create a record of what you remember from the past.
• Copy/Edit. Copy or edit a copy of a previous entry.
• CSV Export. Email or save a numeric file of your data, then open that data in a spreadsheet.
• Interactive Summary & Animation. Play an animation of your data to see how your pain types change within any period you choose by selecting the corresponding start/stop dates.
• PDF Export. Export your charts, drawings, and notes as a PDF file.

PRIVACY IS IMPORTANT.
Your data is stored on your device only and not collected or stored by Nanolume® LLC. Read our End-User License Agreement and Privacy Policy at www.nanolume.com.

Copyright © 2014-2026, Nanolume® LLC. All rights reserved. U.S. Patent No. 11,363,985 B2.

Flightradar24 is a free flight tracker app and includes all the above features. If you want even more great features from Flightradar24 there are two upgrade options—Silver & Gold—and each comes with a free trial.

Flightradar24 Silver
- 90 days of flight tracking history
- More aircraft details, like serial number & age
- More flight details, like vertical speed & squawk
- Filters and alerts to find and track flights you’re interested in
- Current weather at 3,000+ airports overlaid on the map

Flightradar24 Gold
- All the features included in Flightradar24 Silver +
- 365 days of flight history
- Detailed live map weather layers for clouds & precipitation
- Aeronautical charts & oceanic tracks showing the pathways flights follow across the sky
- Air traffic control (ATC) boundaries that show which controllers are responsible for a flight
- Extended Mode S data—even more information about a flight’s altitude, speed, and wind & temperature conditions during flight, when available

Silver and Gold upgrade prices are listed in the app as they vary depending on your country and currency. If you choose to upgrade, subscriptions will be charged to the payment method used for your Google account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You manage your subscription through your Google Play Account Settings.

How it works
Most aircraft today are equipped with ADS-B transponders that transmit positional data. Flightradar24 has a rapidly growing network of over 50,000 ground stations around the world to receive this data that then shows up as aircraft moving on a map in the app. In an expanding number of regions, with the help of multilateration, we’re able to calculate the positions of aircraft that don’t have ADS-B transponders. Coverage in North America is also supplemented by real-time radar data. Coverage is variable and subject to change at any time.

SHIFT WORK MYTHS VS. CIRCADIAN SCIENCE

Shift workers face a serious biological challenge: misalignment between their internal circadian rhythms and their work schedules. This circadian disruption leads to insomnia, excessive sleepiness, poor performance, and increased long-term health risks.

Popular advice — like drinking more coffee, using supplements, or simply “getting more rest” — misses the mark. These approaches don’t address the root cause: your circadian misalignment.

Generic tips won’t solve circadian disruption. Only evidence-based interventions that "reset" your circadian rhythms and manage circadian timing can effectively reduce the negative effects of shift work.

THE REAL SCIENCE OF SHIFT WORK

// In your brain, a circadian clock regulates the rhythm of your day.
// Shift work causes your sleep and other behaviors to occur at biologically inappropriate times, resulting in fatigue, poor sleep, and long-term health risks.
// Light is the most powerful cue for resetting your circadian clock. The correct timing of light exposure and light avoidance is the foundation of any circadian intervention to improve alertness and sleep quality. If your timing is off, it can make things worse.

WHY SHIFT WORKERS LOVE TIMESHIFTER

// Based on the latest sleep and circadian science

NO EXPENSIVE EQUIPMENT REQUIRED

Timeshifter is a highly empowering experience, and it requires no special equipment. Just a sleep mask and your favorite dark sunglasses.

name: VisaStamping
description:
An H-1B visa has two parts to it-the visa petition and visa stamping. After your H-1B visa petition is approved, comes the next part of H-1B Visa stamping, where your visa is endorsed. A H1B visa stamping in the passport is needed for a foreign national to enter/re-enter the United States as an H1B worker. Your visa stamp is one of the requirements to prove that you have valid authorization to travel to the United States.
All H1B visa stamps must be issued by the U.S. consulate outside the USA, situated in your home country and you must appear in person for the interview at the consulate. You will have to apply for the visa stamping about 90 days before you begin working at your new workplace.

PLANT JOURNAL

If you're looking for a way to keep track of your plant's life and get tips on how to care for them, Ploi is the plant app for you! With Ploi, you can log everything from when you watered your plant to when it started to bloom. Plus, our care guides are full of information on how to keep your plants healthy and happy.

GROWTH PROGRESS

If you're like most people, you probably have a few houseplants. Maybe you have a fiddle leaf fig tree or a peace lily. Perhaps you have a snake plant or a succulent. No matter what type of plant you have, it's important to document its growth.

One way to do this is to take photos of your plant at different stages of its life. For example, you might take a photo of your houseplant when you first get it, and then again after a month, and then every few months after that.

Another way to document your plant's growth is to keep a plant journal. In your journal, you can write about how your plant is doing, what changes you've noticed, and how you're caring for it.

Documenting your plant's growth is a great way to keep track of its progress and to create a plant log that you can look back on. Plus, it's a fun way to document your plant's journey from a small seedling to a full-grown plant!

FREE PLANT IDENTIFICATION

FREE PLANT CARE GUIDES

name: PlantNet Plant Identification
description:
Pl@ntNet is an application that allows you to identify plants simply by photographing them with your smartphone. Very useful when you don't have a botanist on hand! Pl@ntNet is also a great citizen science project: all the plants you photograph are collected and analysed by scientists around the world to better understand the evolution of plant biodiversity and to better preserve it.

Pl@ntNet allows you to identify and better understand all kinds of plants living in nature: flowering plants, trees, grasses, conifers, ferns, vines, wild salads or cacti. Pl@ntNet can also identify a large number of cultivated plants (in parks and gardens) but this is not its primary purpose. We especially need Pl@ntNet’s users to inventory the wild plants, those that you can observe in nature of course but also those that grow on the sidewalks of our cities or in the middle of your vegetable garden!

The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant (or the tree if it is one!) is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

At present Pl@ntNet makes it possible to recognize about 20,000 species. We are still a long way from the 360,000 species living on earth, but Pl@ntNet is getting richer every day thanks to the contributions of the most experienced users among you. Don't be afraid to contribute yourself! Your observation will be reviewed by the community and may one day join the photo gallery illustrating the species in the application.

The new version of Pl@ntNet released in January 2019 includes many improvements and new features:
- The ability to filter recognized species by genus or family.
- The differentiated data revision that gives more weight to users who have demonstrated the most skills (in particular the number of species observed, validated by the community).
- The re-identification of shared observations, whether yours or those of other users of the application.
- The multi-flora identification that allows you to search for the photographed plant in all the flora of the application and not only in the one you have selected. Very useful when you are not sure what flora to look for.
- The selection of your favorite floras to access them more quickly.
- The navigation at different taxonomic levels in image galleries.
- The mapping of your observations.
- Links to many factsheets.

The web version of the application is also available at the following address: https://identify.plantnet.org/

Patch planner:

Multiple patchs:

Own varieties:
