name: SuperCook - Recipe Generator
description:
How many times have you found yourself looking for that perfect recipe – only to find that you’re missing one or more ingredients?

How many times have you opened the fridge and thought to yourself -- what can I make ?

How many times have you thrown away an ingredient, because you couldn't figure out how to use it before it expired ?

SuperCook to the rescue!

Unlike other recipe apps, SuperCook only shows you recipes that require the ingredients you already have.

All the recipes you see on SuperCook are recipes you can make right now. No more inconvenient grocery runs for a missing ingredient, at a time when you should be home, with your family and friends

Why purchase new ingredients when you can focus on what you already have?

Here’s how it works:
• For Supercook to do its magic, it needs to know all the ingredients you have at home.
• Visit the pantry page in the SuperCook app and choose from a list of 2000+ ingredients broken down into categories like fruits, vegetables, meats, and many more.
• Start adding ALL the ingredients you have at home to your SuperCook pantry – including oils, spices, and yes - even that old bottle of Worcestershire sauce in the back of the fridge!
• Sit back and watch SuperCook work its magic by finding recipes that match your ingredients.

SuperCook’s Unique App Features:

--Customized Recipe Ideas--
We’ve consolidated over 11 million recipes from 18,000 recipe websites, in 20 languages to create the largest recipe collection ever. This knowledge was fed into an AI system that learnt the intricacies of all ingredients and how they can be mixed together.

All you have to do is build your pantry on the app – and you’re ready to make delicious meals without ever leaving your house!

SuperCook will find you any recipe you need, whether it’s for breakfast, lunch, dinner, or even a midnight snack.

--Easily Add Your Ingredients--
Save time and money with an intelligent pantry. SuperCook’s voice dictation mode allows you to quickly add ingredients to your in-app pantry by simply saying them out loud.

Just open your fridge, click the microphone button, and start listing everything inside. The app will automatically add the ingredients to your pantry for a quick and easy way to find recipes!

--Automatic Recipe Recommendations--
The app will automatically find you recipes to make with what’s in your fridge – so all those lost ingredients in the back of your cupboard now have a place on your table. It’s that simple!

When you run out of an ingredient, simply open the SuperCook app and remove it from your pantry - and all the recipe ideas will adjust accordingly.

--Get Creative in the Kitchen--
SuperCook inspires new ideas and activities in the kitchen for new cooks, busy parents, foodies, and pro chefs alike.

With over 11 million recipes available in 20 different languages, SuperCook promises that you’ll never cook the same thing twice (unless you want to, of course!).

--What's on the menu ?--
The menu page is where you'll find all your recipe ideas. Why is it called menu? Because just like the menu in a restaurant, everything on the menu page is available to you now. SuperCook instantly analyzes 11 million recipes and finds the ones that match your unique ingredients.

Most likely your menu page will contain thousands of recipes, but don't worry, we've broken them down into helpful categories like soups and stews, appetizers and snacks, salads, entrees, desserts and more.

--Reduce food waste--
Most people don't realize how much food they throw away every day — from uneaten leftovers to spoiled produce. SuperCook is one of the best ways to reduce food waste in the home. It finds recipes that use as many of your ingredients as possible, so nothing goes to waste. SuperCook makes food waste prevention fun and easy, just open the menu page on the app and choose a recipe. We help you use what you have, so nothing goes to waste!

description:

The EasyDens & SmartRef deliver highly precise results in seconds and allows you to determine the extract content of your beer. In combination with the Brew Meister app, you can monitor the fermentation process of your handcrafted beer and store the measurement results within customizable batches.

The Brew Meister mobile app supports you in the management, visualization and exportation of data.

FEATURES

Brew Meister reports results in the following units:
• Density [g/cm³]
• Specific Gravity current temperature [SG]
• Specific Gravity 20/20 [SG 20/20]
• Specific Gravity 20/04 [SG 20/04]
• Specific Gravity 20/04 [SG 15/15]
• °Plato [°P] (ATC)
• °Brix [°Bx] (ATC)
• Alcohol Content [% ABV]


• Temperature readings are reported in °Celsius [°C] or °Fahrenheit [°F].
• The concentration values shown on your phone are already temperature-corrected, so you need no further calculations and correction tables.
• The EasyDens is adjusted using the app and distilled water.


For density and concentration measurements, you will require an EasyDens by Anton Paar: http://www.easydens.com
For refractive index readings, you will require a SmartRef by Anton Paar: http://www.my-smartref.com

name: Beer Carbonation Calculator
description:
Force carbonating your homemade beverage (e.g.: beer, ciders, sparkling water, sparkling wine) in your keg requires that you set the correct settings in your CO2 regulator.

This App aims to aid homebrewers in this task, by providing a list of common carbonation values, an easy to use calculator and a table of values by pressure and temperature (commonly known as a carbonation chart) where you can visually find your desired setting.

It supports imperial and metric units as well as both carbonation by volume (Volumes) and by weight (g/L).

Please note that carbonation takes time to happen and this App will only tell you what to set in your cylinder regulator, not for how long. I highly suggest that you look up the web for more information on how to force carbonate before attempting to doing so.

Follow your equipment’s instructions and pressure ratings. Use all applicable safety standards.

name: Partender – Fast Bar Inventory
description:
As featured on Paramount Network's "Bar Rescue" Partender is a patented, subscription-based business tool with a proprietary design that empowers you to:
- Do full, physical bar inventory in just 15 minutes and with up to 99.2% accuracy
- Split up the work across as many users as you'd like on iOS, Android, and even the web
- Generate editable "Smart Orders" based on what you actually went through
- Place, track, and receive those orders online
- Get alerted when prices change
- Get your Usage (for Variance)
- Get your Actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS for Bev Cost %)
- See what’s trending in your venue such as Top Movers and Dead Stock

And besides saving time and labor, our customers:
1) Reduce Inventory Value On-Hand by 20-40%
2) Reduce Beverage Cost by 6-8%
3) Reduce Cost of Goods Fluctuation by 10%

...all in just 90 days of weekly use after setup.

Here’s what some of them had to say:

"Inventory takes less than 15 minutes now. It used to take 2 hours with 3 people counting, for a total of 6 labor hours."
- Grant S. at Boston Pizza

“It takes us just 15 minutes to do inventory, which we do at least twice a week. We stopped running out of things, and thanks to Partender, we managed to get beverage costs down to 20% in a matter of months."
- Mike W. at Marriott

How? Why?

Because when you count your inventory as accurately and as frequently as you count the cash in your register, less disappears. And the average shrinkage in our industry is 23% because no one's counting how much is there.

So when your inventory is 10-50x more valuable than your cash register, it makes sense to count it as carefully as the till, but that's been impossible until Partender.

So throw out your paper-and-pen and homegrown spreadsheets. Do inventory in minutes - not hours. See what's selling the best/worst, what's dead stock (and needs to get phased out via happy hour promotions), and what's about to run out and get 86'd (so you never miss a sale).

Stop manually typing your inventory into Excel or a glorified web-based spreadsheet. Let Partender streamline all of your inventory, ordering, and accounting operations in just 15 minutes a week.

With Partender, you can also:
- Monitor actual depletions
- See real-time customer insights for your actual customers on a per-product or per-category basis
- Instantly receive your Value On-Hand (like a "Balance Sheet") in wholesale and retail dollars after every inventory
- Optimize your par levels (based on online graphs) to buy more of what's selling the best and less of what's selling the worst
- Clearly understand why your cost of goods is going up (due to Price Change Alerts or due to shrinkage* via our Usage / Variance Report online

*Shrinkage is the loss of inventory due to over-pouring, theft, breakage, spillage, not tracking comps, etc. And there's an average 23% shrinkage in the industry which causes 60-80% of bars and restaurants to fail within 3 years. Or let significant amounts of revenue just walk out the door.

HOW DOES PARTENDER WORK?
Build a virtual "blueprint" of your venue after organizing your bar to split up the work of inventory across Main Bar, Back Bar, Stock Room, etc. Instead of manually writing down your inventory using an arbitrary 10-point scale, cumbersome scales, or expensive hardware, simply tap where the liquor level is on the real image of the bottle and swipe to the next bottle on your shelf. That's it! Our proprietary algorithms are up to 99.2% accurate so you know down to the drop & dollar-value how much each bottle is worth in Retail & Wholesale Dollars ($).

INVENTORY ANYTHING:
In addition to liquor, you can inventory beer, wine, smallwares, kegs, and FOOD! Our database is huge. If there's something on your shelf that's not in our database: take a picture of it, and our proprietary algorithms will do the rest.

ANALYTICS IN THE CLOUD:
Just log into your web dashboard to see COGS, beautiful graphs & trends of what customers are drinking in real-time.

Cosmetics:
- Create a list of your cosmetic products to know what you have and what you need, and never use expired products again.
Medicines:
- Keep track of your medicines and make sure you always have enough of the ones you need with a proper shelf life.

One of the most useful features of the app is the ability to add photos or images of the items in your inventory. This makes it even easier to identify and locate the items you're looking for, and helps you keep track of what you have in a more visual and intuitive way.

The app also has the ability to scan and record barcodes. If you've added a barcode to an item, you can later scan it to add or remove the item from your inventory. This makes it easy and convenient to keep track of what you have

Another key feature is the ability to share data with other people and use the app together with your family. Whether you're living with roommates, a partner, or children, this app makes it easy to collaborate and keep everyone on the same page.

Finally, the app also allows you to export your lists to Excel, giving you even more flexibility and control over your inventory and shopping processes. Whether you want to keep a backup of your data or use it in other apps and software, the option to export to Excel is a powerful and convenient feature.

We're always glad to hear your suggestions and are here to help if you need support. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us at chester.help.si+homelist@gmail.com.

So why wait? Download the app today and start taking control of your inventory and shopping processes! Whether you're tracking food supplies, clothes, homeware, tools, hobby collections, cosmetics, medicines, or anything else, this app has you covered.

Join an ever-growing global community of potential allies and enemies. Deploy your army, forge alliances, and fight in nail-biting, turn-based showdowns where the bold and the cunning rule. Challenge real players in online matches across over 120 unique maps, each offering its own wartime scenario - from ancient empires to reliving the greatest historical battles, multiple fantasy scenarios, modern skirmishes & interstellar conflict and galactic wars.

Use clever diplomacy to build alliances, deceive your rivals, and turn temporary friends into stepping stones toward victory. Remember: in this wartime strategy game, trust is fragile, and betrayal is often the final move before triumph.

Battle across an expansive selection of maps, from real-world terrains like Europe and Asia to ancient battlefields and outer space. Each battlefield introduces new pathways to victory that challenge you to employ different strategies, keeping every online match fresh and unpredictable. The classic map is 42 territories. Enjoy the suspense and intensity of the traditional turn-based combat of the classic Hasbro board game. Your tactics must adapt each round as enemies close in, defenses falter, or opportunities arise. Each battle becomes a thrilling test of your long-term planning and decision-making skills.

SOLO & MULTIPLAYER GAME MODES

Play against AI in solo mode or face off with millions of players online or friends in pass & play. Climb the ranks, claim glory and prove your dominance by reaching the prestigious Grandmaster tier.

Stay true to the classic board game rules or game modes that shake up the rules with exciting new twists like Blizzards, Portals, Fog of War, Zombies, Secret Assassin, and Secret Missions. Each mode adds fresh layers of strategy, making every match feel new and dynamic.

Lead your armies, shape the battlefield, and leave your mark on the world stage. With every move, alliance, and turn, you write a new chapter in your legend. Prove you have the mind of a master tactician and download the official RISK: Global Domination today!.

IS THIS GAME RIGHT FOR YOU?
This game is best for people:
• Who recognize the strength of neural network backgammon bots

• 4 skill levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert

• Doubling cube
• Single games or match play up to 25 pts

• 1-player mode vs. computer
• 2-player mode on one device
• User-friendly, tap-to-move interface
• Highlighted checker movement options

• Match analysis (in-app purchase): Analyze past match files, view moves & errors for match, step through match, jump to position, play from position, save match files permanently

IMPORTANT
If you're having issues:
• Make sure a task killer isn't killing BGNJ processes.
• Run BGNJ from main memory, not from memory card.

name: Pancia : Batch Cooking
description:
Préparez des repas équilibrés en un clin d'œil avec Pancia, votre compagnon culinaire ultime ! Notre application intuitive vous permet de planifier facilement vos repas pour plusieurs jours, en suivant les recommandations nutritionnelles et en vous offrant une expérience de cuisine pratique, saine et sans stress.

Planification de repas simplifiée
Dites adieu à la question quotidienne "Qu'est-ce que l'on mange ce soir ?" Pancia vous permet de planifier vos repas en avance, que ce soit pour vous-même ou pour toute votre famille. Indiquez simplement le nombre de jours et les membres de votre famille, et notre application générera un planning alimentaire complet. Fini les tracas de décider quoi cuisiner chaque jour !

Liste de courses optimisée
Une fois votre planning de repas établi, Pancia vous fournit une liste de courses complète et optimisée. Vous y trouverez tous les ingrédients nécessaires pour préparer vos délicieux repas équilibrés. Ne perdez plus de temps à errer dans les rayons du supermarché ou à oublier des ingrédients essentiels. Notre liste de courses vous simplifie la vie et vous fait économiser de l'argent en évitant les achats impulsifs.

Préparation d'ingrédients intelligente
Avec Pancia, la préparation des ingrédients devient un jeu d'enfant. Notre application vous propose des ingrédients qui peuvent être préparés en une seule session de cuisine en utilisant une méthode de batchcooking. Économisez du temps en préparant tous vos ingrédients en une seule fois, que ce soit en les découpant, en les cuisant ou en les portionnant. Vous n'aurez plus qu'à assembler les ingrédients lors de la préparation de chaque repas, pour une expérience culinaire fluide et sans tracas.

Recettes savoureuses et équilibrées
Pancia regorge de recettes savoureuses, adaptées à tous les goûts et tous les régimes alimentaires. Nous nous engageons à vous offrir des repas équilibrés avec une bonne répartition en protéines, glucides et lipides, conformément aux recommandations nutritionnelles de Santé Publique France. Nos recettes sont simples à suivre, avec des ingrédients disponibles dans tous les supermarchés. Même les plus novices en cuisine pourront préparer des plats délicieux et nourrissants en un rien de temps.

Bon pour votre santé et la planète
Chez Pancia, nous croyons en une alimentation saine qui profite à votre santé et à l'environnement. Notre application propose des portions adaptées à votre morphologie et à votre niveau d'activité physique, en complément d'un petit-déjeuner équilibré. Nous favorisons également l'utilisation d'ingrédients de saison, des recettes ayant un faible impact sur l'environnement, et nous encourageons la réduction du gaspillage alimentaire. Avec Pancia, vous pourrez prendre soin de votre bien-être tout en étant respectueux de la planète.

Repas sains et abordables
Nous croyons fermement que manger sainement ne doit pas être synonyme de dépenses excessives. Pancia vous propose des repas équilibrés à 4 euros maximum par personne. Dites adieu aux fast-foods coûteux et aux écarts de votre budget. Nous vous aidons à économiser de l'argent en vous fournissant une liste de courses soigneusement élaborée, évitant les achats superflus et les dépenses inutiles.

Simplifiez votre vie, prenez soin de votre santé et découvrez le plaisir de cuisiner avec Pancia. Téléchargez notre application dès maintenant et commencez à préparer des repas équilibrés en un rien de temps.

name: Recipe Scaler – Portion & Cost
description:
"Only have 240g of flour left?"

Stop doing mental math in the kitchen. [Recipe Scaler – Portion & Cost] is your professional kitchen assistant and business accountant in one app.

■ Why 'Recipe Scaler'?
Most apps only offer simple servings multiplication. Our app allows you to scale an entire recipe based on a single ingredient's weight and provides professional costing analysis including labor, waste (loss rate), and overheads.

■ Key Features
1. Intelligent Scaling
- Resize based on any ingredient. Enter the amount of one item, and everything else adjusts in perfect proportion.
- Precision measurement with decimal-point accuracy for professional baking.
2. Professional Costing & Pricing
- Instantly calculate cost-per-unit from purchase prices.
- Advanced Analysis: Include Loss Rate(%), Labor Time, and Overheads for a true professional profit report.
- Smart Pricing: Set your target markup and see suggested selling prices immediately.
3. Share without App Install
- Share your scaled recipes via a simple web link.
- Recipients can view and interact with your recipe in their mobile browser without downloading anything!

■ Perfect for:
- Professionals: Manage catering, bakeries, or bulk cooking with profit in mind.
- Home Cooks: Optimize recipes based on available ingredients to reduce waste.
- Creators: Share adjustable "Golden Ratio" recipes with your audience easily.
"Bring precision and profitability to your kitchen."
Download [Recipe Scaler] today and make cooking smarter, easier, and more cost-efficient!

name: Recipe Calculator
description:
The Kitchen Calculator app by MyKitchenCalculator.com is a tool that includes a recipe converter (recipe multiplier), cooking references, and several conversion calculators that help you easily convert between the most common measuring units used in cooking and baking.

The recipe converter tool allows you to scale, multiply, divide, or portion your recipes to the serving size you desire. Easily convert recipes to your desired serving size by typing in (*or copying and pasting*) the ingredients from your favorite online food blogs or recipe sites.

*Note: Due to the nature of text formatting, the copy and paste function may not work directly for some websites and certain mobile browsers.

The ingredient unit converter tool allows you to convert by ingredient between volume and weight units, such as cups and grams. Choose from more than 250 of the most common ingredients, such as butter, eggs, flour, and sugar!

The tool also includes basic conversion calculators for Volume, Weight, Length, Energy, Time, and Temperature. For most conversions, you can directly type in fractions as an input value, such as "1 1/2" or "3/4". The tool also keeps a history of your past conversions.

In addition to conversion calculators, the app has a Gas Mark reference and a cooking temperature references that allows you to quickly look up information about cooking temperatures for meat, candy, and other dishes.

Take the power of recipe conversion with you by downloading this app. MyKitchenCalculator.com, recipe conversion made easier!

Recipe Converter:
Multiply, divide, or portion recipes with ease. This tool will take fraction inputs and output them to the nearest fraction also!

Ingredient Unit Converter:
Convert by ingredient between common volume and weight units for more than 250 ingredients! Includes sticks of butter conversion and conversion of medium, large, and x-large whole eggs!

Volume Converter:
Convert between units of teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons, fluid ounces, milliliters, liters. You can also convert between US and UK (imperial) units. There is also a conversion to "Cups and Spoons". This conversion will convert volume units to denominations of common measuring cups and spoons. For example, 1.75 cups = 1 cup + 3/4 cup.

Weight Converter:
Convert between units of grams, kilograms, ounces, and pounds. You can even convert to "Pounds and Ounces".

Length Converter:
Convert between units of millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards and miles. You can even convert to "Feet and Inches".

Energy Converter:
Convert between Joules, Kilojoules, Gram Calories, and Food Calories (Kilocalories)

Time Converter:
Convert between seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.

Temperature Converter:
Convert between units of Fahrenheit, Celsius, and Kelvin.

Gas Mark Reference:
View common gas mark settings in Fahrenheit or Celsius.

Cooking Temperatures:
Easily look up the USDA recommended cooking temperatures of most dishes such as meats, eggs, and casseroles. You can also look up candy cooking temperatures that tell you the stages of sugar at each temperature range.

Easily share your conversions with others if your device has compatible share action apps such as certain email or text messaging apps.

Notes:
1)Conversions are calculated approximations and may not be exact.
2)US volume conversions are NIST based rounded values.
3)Conversions by ingredients are based on USDA values and actual measured values.
4)Always check for proper conversions before using converted recipes.
5)This tool is based on rounded and simplified values and is not recommended for mathematical, engineering, or scientific calculations that need precision.

name: Moodi: emotions & mood tracker
description:
Moodi is a self-help therapy journal with effective psychological exercises and emotion tracker to strengthen your mental health and overcome anxiety & depression, stress, low self-esteem, or other psychological difficulties. Take advantage of this CBT mood diary therapy and help yourself to raise your mood, increase awareness, and enjoy its anti-stress effect.


A psychological diary is a highly effective self-help practice


Psychologists recommend keeping a psychological diary. It can be an emotion tracker, a mood diary a CBT journal, or free-form entries.


As the best self-help practice, it will help you:


  • Better understand yourself, your thoughts, feelings, reactions, and relationships with other people

  • Express emotions and experiences, rather than suppressing them, and ensure better emotional regulation and stress reduction

  • Approach problem-solving and decision-making mindfully

  • Identify sources of stress and anxiety and find ways to cope with them

  • Improve personal development and growth

Self-help practices you will find in this mental health therapy app


Negative situations diary


A Negative Situations Diary is a very effective self-help technique for solving psychological problems. It will help you cope with painful and anxious moments more easily, understand how some events affect your feelings and mood, and strategize your reactions for similar situations in the future.


Make entries about every negative moment, track your thoughts, mark emotions, and select a cognitive distortion. With this therapy journal, you can better understand yourself, your behavior, and your feelings associated with a specific event. Help yourself to free your mind from negativity, and feel much better. By changing your approach to resolving negative situations, your reaction to them will also change.


Positive moments diary


In the Positive Moments Diary (Gratitude Journal), you can write down all your positive events, good emotions, and gratitude. It helps you pay attention to the pleasant moments and, thus, reduce stress and other negative feelings.


Everything that causes positive emotions truly matters. So, use these positive emotions for self-help mindfully. Whether you had a significant event or something fleeting, write it down and mark the emotions you experienced. And motivate yourself.


Morning diary


With the Morning Diary, you can help yourself set up for the day ahead and free your mind from needless worries, irrational anxieties, and negativity. By practicing this morning diary and mood tracker, you will notice how your energy, motivation, awareness, and creativity rise.


Write down your emotions, feelings, experiences, plans, tasks, goals, and desires every day, immediately after you wake up. Write down everything that seems important to you at that moment.


Evening diary


An Evening Diary is an effective self-help practice. With it, you can track your emotions, feelings, and thoughts at the end of the day, right before going to bed. With this mental health tracker, you can analyze your day and get rid of unfounded worries, stress and tension, anxiety & depression. All this helps you relax, sleep better, and recover.


Write down your events and impressions of the past day. Describe your emotions, feelings, self-esteem, and physical condition in detail. Write down the lesson you learn from this day. Don't try to write it correctly, just be honest and record things you believe to be important for you at that moment.


Download Moodi, a CBT therapy journal and mental health tracker. Put one of the most effective self-help practices on your service. Trace and analyze your negative situations and positive moments, and keep a morning journal and evening mood diary. Learn to save and cherish positive feelings and get rid of anxiety & depression.

description:

DRUG INFORMATION & EDUCATION

Check the profiles of more than 200 drugs for educational purposes: Stimulants like MDMA and Amphetamine, depressants such as Alcohol and Benzodiazepines or psychedelics like 2C-B, LSD and DMT.

KnowDrugs provides you with drug education harm reduction advice, focusing on MDMA / Molly / Ecstasy and other psychoactive substances. Knowing about the wanted and unwanted effects of drugs, their duration, interactions and risks helps you to make more informed decisions, reduce risks and reflect upon your drug habits and consumption behaviour.

DRUG CHECKING, PILL WARNINGS & DRUG ALERTS

Search for drug name, substance or location, to find drug alerts from nearby and learn about their ingredients and dosage strength to avoid overdose and particularly dangerous cuts (e.g. PMA).

Drug checking or pill testing is a way to reduce the harm from drug consumption by allowing users to find out the content and purity of substances that they intend to consume. This empowers users to make safer choices: to avoid more dangerous substances and combination and to use smaller quantities.

If you don't have access to professional drug testing services, looking up recent drug testing results can still help you make a more informed decision about your consumption.

HARM REDUCTION & RESPONSIBLE DRUG USE

Harm reduction aims to minimize the harms associated with recreational substance use. The harm reduction approach follows from the idea that substance use is a high-risk activity that innately entails the possibility of injury, addiction, and death. Therefore, the best strategy one can employ (outside of avoiding use entirely) is to take appropriate measures to mitigate its potential harms.

KnowDrugs highlights the harm-potential of more than 200 substances and demonstrates strategies on how to reduce the harms associated with the consumption of drugs.

KNOWDRUGS CAN ALSO HELP YOU TO:

- learn how to spot and react in case of an emergency, take care of someone experiencing a bad trip at a party or festival
- find a free and confidential counselling service which accepts you and your personal choices, and helps you develop the right strategies and competencies if you want to change something about your consumption behaviour.

name: Loop Habit Tracker
description:
Loop helps you create and maintain good habits, allowing you to achieve your long-term goals. Detailed charts and statistics show you how your habits improved over time. The app is completely ad-free, open source and it respects your privacy.


Simple, beautiful and modern interface
Loop has a minimalistic interface that is very easy to use and follows the material design guidelines.

Habit score
In addition to showing your current streak, Loop has an advanced formula for calculating the strength of your habits. Every repetition makes your habit stronger, and every missed day makes it weaker. A few missed days after a long streak, however, will not completely destroy your entire progress, unlike other don't-break-the-chain apps.

Detailed graphs and statistics
Clearly see how your habits improved over time with detailed charts and statistics. Scroll back to see the complete history of your habits.

Flexible schedules
Supports not only daily habits, but also habits with more complex schedules, such as 3 times every week; one time every other week; or every other day.

Reminders
Create an individual reminder for each habit, at a chosen hour of the day. Easily check, dismiss or snooze your habit directly from the notification, without opening the app.

Widgets
Track your habits directly from your home screen, with beautiful and colorful widgets.

Completely ad-free and open source
There are absolutely no advertisements, annoying notifications or intrusive permissions in this app, and there will never be. The complete source code is available under an open-source license (GPLv3).

Works offline and respects your privacy
Loop doesn't require an Internet connection or online account registration. Your confidential habit data never leaves your phone. Neither the developers nor any third-parties have access to it.

Take your data with you
If you want to further analyze your data or move it to another service, Loop allows you to export it to spreadsheets (CSV) or to a database format (SQLite).

description:
» Organize Your Life!
HabitBull is the most powerful multi-platform companion to keep track of your day to day habits and routines

» Fully Customisable

» Cut Bad Habits From Your Life
Simply start tracking bad habits like nail biting, smoking or drinking too much. Once you see the patterns, it's easier to break them. HabitBull keeps you accountable. Also great for users of NoFap!

» Add Some Positive Habits
Want to go for a nice walk every day? Or maybe give 3 hugs every Saturday and Sunday? Join us on this journey!

» Who is it for?
Whether you want to read some more, stop smoking, start working out or even just track how many hours you wasted on Facebook, this app lets you do it!

» Features
•  Track multiple habits, repeated to do's or goals, each in its own calendar
•  Streak counter and percentage successful for each habit
•  Yes/No or Number goals
•  Very flexible goals like: number of times per day/week/month, only on certain days of the week etc. For example: 30 push ups every Mon-Fri, go to the gym 2 times per week, or even every 2 days
•  Inspiring quotes per category - including actual quotes from people doing it (meditation, reading, stop drinking alcohol, stop smoking cigarettes, stop procrastination etc)
•  Graphs with success percentage / streak, entered values etc
•  Powerful reminders - multiple times per day, repeating within a time period, sound and vibrate optional
•  Home screen / lock screen widget
•  Multi-device syncing
•  Cloud backup
•  Motivational images
•  Export to CSV
•  Dark theme
•  Google Fit integration

» How it works:
1. Set up a habit
2. Tell HabitBull how you went for a day
3. Watch your daily streak increase

Habits are no more than routines which you perform subconsciously. To build one - train yourself. To break one, find another one which is similar, yet different and nicer, and repeat it until it sticks.

To assist you with this HabitBull lets you set reminders for each habit and displays them on days when you need to be successful. This is especially useful if you have a to do list with repeating tasks or if you want to be reminded to do the same thing every day. It can also be used as a calendar planning tool or checklist, but also as a very effective repeating reminder (e.g. to drink water every 2 hours).

HabitBull does feel a little like a game in which you compete with yourself. The task is to get a long streak for the habit you are working on by covering your goals. The longer the better. It takes a couple of months to fully build a new routine, so don't give up - it takes time and if you are consistent it will work; even if it takes a few attempts.

There are many things which you may want to improve. HabitBull can be used as a planner in building habits like taking your pills regularly, exercise, or keep to a diet. It can also be used as a helper for people suffering from memory problems. As for your vices, HabitBull can be a useful goal tracking tool, or a smart notebook, to assist you while breaking bad habits like nail-biting, drinking alcohol and even improving your dating skills.
It is entirely up to you, really. But why not give it a try and have a convenient helper on the go?

Habicat is a retro pixel-art gamified habit tracker and goal planner. Here, you are not just checking off a daily routine—you are leveling up your own hero.

Why is it so hard to build good habits and beat procrastination? Because real life lacks instant feedback. Treat self-discipline like an endless RPG. You don't need to rescue a princess; the only bosses you need to defeat are laziness and bad habits.

Whether you're a student building a study routine or a professional striving for better time management, Habicat makes your progress visible and incredibly fun.

----- Key Features -----

👾 Retro Pixel Art Design: A complete 8-bit visual style. Clean, intuitive, and engaging. Say goodbye to boring checklists.

🎮 RPG Leveling System: Complete your daily tasks to earn gold, level up your hero, and upgrade your gear! Every step forward makes your character stronger in real life and in the game.

----- A Note from the Developer -----

I believe our lives can be just as engaging as our favorite games.

As an indie developer, I was deeply inspired by Jane McGonigal’s book Reality Is Broken. Why do we invest so much effort into virtual worlds but struggle with long-term goals in reality? The secret lies in "the driving force of instant feedback."

I created Habicat to give you that instant, positive reinforcement on your journey to becoming your best self. This is a continuously maintained indie project. I will keep adding new gear, bosses, and features to accompany you in this "infinite game" of life.

Why Foreceipt?

How to Scan?

To scan your receipts and bills using Foreceipt, simply tap the scan icon at the bottom. Place your phone above the receipt on a plain, dark background. Foreceipt uses OCR technology to accurately read the merchant and payment data to convert your paper bills & receipts into digital receipts. You can edit, verify or delete your receipts once scanned. Foreceipt is the most convenient expense tracker available.

Key App features:

* Real-time processing - The receipt scanning process is quick. It will save & organize the extracted data immediately on the cloud. You will not need the receipt after scanning it, as your data is processed in real time.

* Security - Our integration with Google Drive is completely secure. There is no external interference from ads. Foreceipt does not allow any data mining and your data is only accessible to you.

* Monthly Budget Planner - You can track your spending, income, & balances monthly. Create categories to manage your financial reporting & budget. This app is a bookkeeper that’ll make money-saving & bank account reconciliation trouble-free.

* Cloud-Based - Foreceipt saves data on the cloud, which makes it accessible from any device at any time. You don’t have to deal with the hassle of storing your receipts for months.

* Offline Access - Saved data can be viewed without internet access. The app will automatically sync & organize with the cloud the next time you’re online.

* Cross-Device Accessibility - The app can be logged into on multiple devices (Android, iOS, & web) and will keep the data synchronized. Upon making any changes in the app, the updated data will be visible on all devices. Auto synchronization makes Foreceipt a receipt tracker app for both a family or a business.

* Charts & Grids - View data charts to get an overview of your expenses, savings, & current balance. You can pick the categories and the format you want to view your finances in.

Foreceipt is the most sophisticated and advanced receipt organizer app you will find to scan, track & manage your money & expenses. Organize finance reports, budgets & track your tax refund on any smartphone, tablet or desktop. Make Foreceipt your personal bookkeeper. Download the app now and make bookkeeping a breeze.

name: Product Management - CraftUp
description:
CraftUp is the product management learning app for product managers, aspiring PMs, founders, designers and developers who want to build better products. It helps you learn product management step by step with short, focused daily lessons you can actually apply in your work and side projects.

If you want to start a product management career, move from junior to mid or senior product manager, or simply make smarter product decisions as a founder, CraftUp gives you a clear, structured path. You learn modern product management, not random tips or outdated theory.

CraftUp is built around real product work. Each lesson focuses on one concrete product management decision: understanding a user problem, validating an idea, designing an MVP, planning a simple experiment, running user interviews, defining product metrics, or deciding what to ship next. You do not just read about product management, you practice product thinking every day.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

With CraftUp you will learn core product management skills, including:

How to find real problems worth solving using user research

How to validate ideas with interviews, surveys and simple experiments

How to design and build MVPs that test the right product assumptions

How to get your first users and grow from zero with limited time and budget

How to use feedback, data and metrics to improve your product

How to understand product market fit and avoid false signals

How to prioritize a roadmap when everything feels important

How to make better product decisions with scarce resources

How to think and communicate like a product manager or founder

This is practical product management training you can use if you are preparing for a PM role, already working as a product manager, or building your own startup.

WHO CRAFTUP IS FOR

CraftUp is designed for:

People starting from zero who want a clear way to learn product management

Aspiring product managers preparing for their first PM job or interview

Junior product managers who want to grow faster and build confidence

Founders and indie hackers who need product management skills to ship smarter

Designers and developers who want to understand product decisions, not just tickets

Professionals in other fields who want to learn product thinking and turn ideas into products

HOW IT WORKS

CraftUp breaks product management into small, guided steps. Lessons are short, structured and focused on one topic at a time. You can complete a lesson in a few minutes, but over time you build deep understanding of how real product management works.

You learn how to frame user problems, write simple hypotheses, design experiments, pick metrics that matter, and make tradeoffs. Many lessons use examples from real products and real product managers so you see how product thinking works in practice, not in theory.

WHY CRAFTUP IS DIFFERENT

CraftUp is not another generic business course or a playlist of long video lectures. It is a dedicated product management learning environment. The content is focused only on product management and product thinking. No fluff, no motivational noise, just clear explanations and concrete actions.

The experience is calm and intentional. You will not find growth hacking tricks or pressure to hustle more. Instead, CraftUp helps you build a consistent learning habit so you actually stick with product management over weeks and months. You get just enough structure to keep moving forward without feeling overwhelmed.

CraftUp is your companion in the messy but rewarding process of learning product management and turning ideas into real products. Whether you want to become a product manager, level up in your current role, or build your own product as a founder, CraftUp gives you the product management skills, mindset and practice you need.

Learn product management. Build better products.

name: Return Reminder: Refund Alert
description:
Return Reminder & Tracker – Never Miss an Online Refund Again

Return Reminder is the smart return tracker and refund reminder app that follows every return deadline from your favorite online stores and warns you BEFORE the window closes. Paste a product link, let the app auto-fill everything in seconds and stop losing money on forgotten returns from Amazon, AliExpress, SHEIN, Zalando, IKEA and more.

★ WHY YOU NEED IT ★
Every retailer has a different policy: 14, 30, 60 or even 365 days. Remembering all of them is impossible. Return Reminder is your personal refund tracker and shopping organizer, so you never throw money away on a product you didn't want to keep.

★ KEY FEATURES ★
• Track unlimited online purchases and return deadlines in one place
• Paste a product link and auto-fill name, image, price and return period
• Three smart tabs: Active, Expiring soon and Finished
• Color-coded countdown showing days left
• "Amount at risk" view: see how much money is on the line
• Product photos from gallery or camera
• Multi-currency support
• Mark products as Deciding, Returned or Kept
• Multi-select delete and undo actions
• Dark, light and system theme
• Available in 34 languages
• 100% offline by default
• Lightweight, fast and battery friendly

★ AUTO-FILL FROM YOUR FAVORITE STORES ★
Share or paste a product link and Return Reminder extracts the title, image, price and return window automatically. Supported stores: Amazon, AliExpress, SHEIN, Temu, Zalando, Zara, IKEA, MediaMarkt, Decathlon, El Corte Inglés, Fnac, PcComponentes, ASOS, H&M, Adidas, Nike, Joom, Best Buy, Walmart, Target, eBay, Etsy and more.

Missing your favorite store? Contact us and we'll add it.

★ SMART RETURN NOTIFICATIONS ★
Get reminded before every return deadline with notifications at 14, 7, 3 and 1 day before expiry (Pro). Choose your reminder time in Settings. No more "I should have returned that last week".

★ MONEY STATISTICS (PRO) ★
See how much this return tracker helps you protect every month:
• Total spent and money currently at risk
• Money recovered by returning on time
• Returns made and missed
• Breakdown by store
• Filters: 30 days, 90 days, 6 months, all time or custom

★ CLOUD SYNC (PRO) ★
Sign in with your Google account to keep your products synchronized across all your devices. Switch phones without losing a single return. Cloud data can be deleted any time from Settings.

★ HOW IT WORKS ★
1. Tap + and paste a product link, or fill it in manually.
2. Return Reminder calculates the exact last day you can return the item.
3. Get timely notifications before the deadline arrives.
4. Mark the product as Returned or Kept and watch your savings grow.

★ FREE & PRO ★
Return Reminder is free to download. Upgrade to Pro with a single ONE-TIME purchase (no subscriptions, ever) to unlock:
• Unlimited active products (free version supports up to 5)
• No ads
• Money statistics with charts and store breakdown
• Advanced notifications at 14, 7, 3 and 1 day before deadline
• Cloud sync across devices with Google sign-in

★ PRIVACY FIRST ★
Your purchases are personal. Return Reminder stores everything locally by default. Cloud sync is fully optional. Manage ad consent and read the Privacy Policy from Settings any time.

★ PERFECT FOR ★
• Online shoppers buying from multiple stores
• Fashion lovers ordering several sizes to try at home
• Tech enthusiasts buying electronics with long return windows
• Gift buyers who need flexibility
• Anyone who hates losing money to forgotten refunds

Take control of your online shopping with Return Reminder & Tracker — the ultimate return deadline tracker, refund reminder and money saver for Android. Download today and never miss a return again. Your wallet will thank you.

name: Allday HVAC Calc
description:
The application can be useful for HVAC engineers and contains 3 modules.

Psychrometric Calculator - this module determines air properties based on input values such as dry-bulb temperature, wet-bulb temperature, and relative humidity. It provides results like humidity ratio, specific volume, enthalpy, and vapor pressure in both SI and IP units.

Pipe Calculator - this module is used to calculate velocity and pressure loss in pipelines and to select pipeline diameters for a given maximum velocity and pressure loss. The module supports interdependent calculations of flow rate, heat load, and fluid temperatures: when any three of these parameters are specified, the fourth is calculated automatically. It can also be used as a reference for heat transfer fluid properties and pipe characteristics.

Duct Calculator - the module is used to calculate the speed and pressure loss in round, rectangular and oval air ducts when moving wet or dry air through them, as well as to select their sections for a given maximum speed and maximum pressure loss. Additionally, the heating or cooling power is calculated for a given air flow rate, or reverse calculations: air flow rate for a given power; temperature of incoming or outgoing air for a given power and flow rate. It can also be used as a reference material for determining the properties of wet and dry air at different pressures and temperatures.

Also in the description sections are the reference formulas by which the calculations are made.

Web version: calc.ashrae-meteo.info

Llama Life let’s you set a countdown timer for *every* task. This concept is called ‘timeboxing’, and the idea is to create a (positive) constraint around the time we have to do something. The goal is to try and give a task 100% of our attention, until the timer runs out. This helps to increase focus, and gives us the mental space to think about ONE thing at a time.

Llama Life also let’s you know your total List Time, and the estimated finishing time, so you can be more aware of time passing, and plan your day.

We also love celebrating the wins, big or small, so very importantly, you get confetti (woo hoo!) when you finish a task. You can also personalize with color and emoji to get lots of variety and keep things fun and fresh!

Llama Life offers a 7-day free trial, with a Monthly or Annual subscription.

I'm so glad you’re here, and are rooting for your success!

All the best,
Marie
Founder, Llama Life

name: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Bring structure to your workflow by utilising time blocking technique.


Time blocking is an effective strategy for using time wisely and achieving greater results. Blocking out time for specific activities allows you to focus on one task at a time, limit distractions and procrastination.


It's really simple to use:


1. Define your tasks at hand, make a task list.

2. Define a block of time during which you will eliminate all distractions and give all your focus to your tasks. Start the timer and work.

3. Take frequent breaks. Regular breaks are conducive to greater productivity and concentration. During these breaks take a breath of fresh air, do some push-ups, stretch or anything else that helps you to restore your power. Your body will thank you.

4. Repeat this work/break cycle and take a longer breaks when you feel you need to.


Daily goal setting, minimalistic design beautiful color themes, notifications and more.

description:
Mindbody is the world's #1 booking platform for fitness, beauty, and wellness experiences. We encourage people to try new things and find what makes them feel physically, mentally, and spiritually their best.

With over 40k+ studios around the world, we offer top fitness classes like yoga, Pilates, barre, dance, HIIT, bootcamp, and more. Looking for something along the lines of a massage, hair treatment, or cryotherapy? We've got that too. Plus, you'll find promoted intro offers and last-minute deals—it's all on the app.

How it works:
• Download the free app, then create a Mindbody account (or log in to your existing account) to get started.
• Enter your location at the top of the screen to see local intro offers, price drops, and deals near you.
• Looking for something in particular? Jump to the "SEARCH" icon at the bottom of the window to find businesses near you. From there, you can type in the desired service or browse popular categories.
• Need to refine your results? Filter your search by business, class, date, time, distance, or category. You can also sort based on what's recommended, top-rated or closest to you.
• Once you select a class or appointment, you can read up on reviews, instructor & service provider bios, and how to get there. You can also choose a business first to learn more about their amenities, schedule, services, location, and pricing.
• When you're ready to secure your service, select the "Book" button in the right-hand corner. From there, you will be asked to confirm your payment information. Plug in your info, then hit "BOOK AND BUY" to make it official.

Why you'll love it:
Variety: You've got local fitness, beauty, salon, spa, and wellness options in the palm of your hand—you decide what works for you.
Value: You'll get the best deals to try a new studio or drop-in on a fitness class without committing to a membership.

name: Google Fit: Activity Tracking
description:
Get to a healthier and more active life with the new Google Fit!

It's hard to know how much or what kind of activity you need to stay healthy. That's why Google Fit collaborated with the World Health Organization (WHO) and the American Heart Association (AHA) to bring you Heart Points, an activity goal that can help improve your health.

Activities that get your heart pumping harder have tremendous health benefits for your heart and mind. You'll earn one Heart Point for each minute of moderate activity like picking up the pace when walking your dog, and double points for more intense activities like running. It takes just 30-minutes of brisk walking five days a week to reach the AHA and WHO's recommended amount of physical activity shown to reduce the risk of heart disease, improve sleep, and increase overall mental wellbeing.

Google Fit will also help you:

TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS FROM YOUR PHONE OR WATCH
Get instant insights when you exercise and see real-time stats for your runs, walks, and bike rides. Fit will use your Android phone's sensors or Wear OS by Google smartwatch's heart rate sensors to record your speed, pace, route, and more.

MONITOR YOUR GOALS
See your daily progress on your Heart Points and Steps goal. Meeting your goals all the time? Easily adjust your goals to keep challenging yourself to achieve a healthy heart and mind.

MAKE ALL YOUR MOVEMENT COUNT
If you walk, run, or bike throughout the day, your Android phone or Wear OS by Google smartwatch will automatically detect and add your activities to your Google Fit journal to ensure you get credit for every move. Want extra credit? Turn up the tempo on your walks by starting a paced walking workout and stepping to the beat. Enjoy a different type of workout? Select it from a list of activities like pilates, rowing, or spinning, and Google Fit will track all the Heart Points you earn.

CONNECT WITH YOUR FAVORITE APPS AND DEVICES
Fit can show you info from many of your favorite apps and devices to give you a holistic view of your health, so you'll never lose track of your progress. These include Lifesum, Wear OS by Google, Nike+, Runkeeper, Strava, MyFitnessPal, Basis, Sleep as Android, Withings, Xiaomi Mi bands, and more.

CHECK IN AT ANYTIME, FROM ANYWHERE
See a snapshot of your activity history across Fit and your integrated apps in the redesigned journal. Or, get the full picture in browse, where you can find all of your health and wellness data.

KEEP A FINGER ON THE PULSE OF YOUR HEALTH
Breathing is one of the simplest ways to reduce tension and relieve stress. With Fit, checking in with your breath is easy—all you need is your phone camera. As well as your respiratory rate, you can measure your heart rate to get a better understanding of your body’s wellbeing.

VIEW YOUR DAY'S STATS AT A GLANCE

Learn more about Google Fit and see a list of supported apps at: www.google.com/fit

name: Accu​Battery
description:
Accu​Battery displays battery usage information, and measures battery capacity (mAh) based on science.
 
❤ BATTERY HEALTH
 
Batteries have a limited lifespan. Every time you charge your device, it wears out the battery, lowering its total capacity.

- Use our charge alarm to remind you to unplug your charger.
- Discover how much battery wear was endured during your charge session.
 
📊 BATTERY USE
 
Accu​Battery measures the actual battery usage using information from the battery charge controller. Battery usage per app is determined by combining these measurements with information on which app is in the foreground. Android calculates battery usage using pre-baked profiles that device manufacturers provide, like how much power the CPU uses. In practice however, these numbers tend to be highly inaccurate.
 
- Monitor how much battery your device is using
- Know how long you can use your device when it’s active or in standby mode
- Find out how much power each app uses.
- Check how often your device gets woken up from deep sleep.
 
🔌 CHARGE SPEED
 
Use Accu​Battery to find the fastest charger and USB cable for your device. Measure the charging current (in mA) to find out!
 
- Check how fast your device is charging when the screen is on or off.
- Know how long it takes to charge your phone and when it’s finished.
 
HIGHLIGHTS
 
- Measure real battery capacity (in mAh).
- See how much wear your battery sustains with each charge session.
- Look up the discharge speed and battery consumption per app.
- Remaining charge time - know how long it takes before your battery is charged.
- Remaining use time - know when you will run out of battery.
- Screen on or screen off estimations.
- Check the percentage of deep sleep, when the device is in standby mode.
- Ongoing notification for real time battery statistics at a glance.
 
🏆 PRO FEATURES
 
- Use Dark and AMOLED black themes to save energy.
- Access to historical sessions older than 1 day.
- Detailed battery statistics in notification.
- No ads
 
We're a small, independent app developer with a focus on quality and passion for battery statistics. AccuBattery doesn’t require access to privacy-sensitive information and doesn't make false claims. If you like the way we work, support us by upgrading to the Pro version.

name: Introvert - Be Social
description:
Embracing your inner extrovert might feel like stepping into uncharted territory, but fear not! Becoming more social is an exciting journey that begins with simple steps, gradually leading to newfound confidence and sociability.

Start by taking baby steps into the world of social interactions. Begin with small talk; strike up a conversation with a friendly neighbor, a co-worker, or someone waiting in line. Practice active listening - it's an art that helps you connect more deeply with others.

Challenge yourself to attend social gatherings or events. It might feel daunting at first, but remember, each experience is a chance to grow. Push your comfort zone a little each time. Maybe set a goal to attend one social event a week, or even a month, to start with.

Join clubs or groups that align with your interests. Whether it's a book club, a hiking group, or a cooking class, being around like-minded individuals can make socializing feel more natural and enjoyable.

Practice positive self-talk. Encourage yourself along the way. Acknowledge your progress and celebrate the little victories. Remember, Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither is the confident extrovert version of yourself!

Lastly, be patient and kind to yourself. Transforming into a more social butterfly takes time. Rome wasn’t built in a day, and neither will your social prowess. Each step you take, no matter how small, is a stride toward a more confident and outgoing you.

So, get ready to spread your wings and dive into the wonderful world of social interactions. You've got this!

name: Diem: Big Group Chat Energy
description:
AI Search, Community Chats

Welcome to Diem! We’re building your new front door to the internet.

Diem is a search-engine-meets-social-network designed first for girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks. You can search the internet with Diem AI and find answers to anything life throws at you. “How do I get over a friend breakup? What’s the best way to negotiate salary? My boyfriend follows models on Instagram—is that a red flag?” Diem is here to help.

Our platform is also full of novel, collective knowledge from people all over the world. You can socialize your search to start conversations, discover a network of communities, connect over shared experiences and browse trending topics.

Joining Diem means showing up with no judgment and immersing yourself in the candid, funny, authentic, important, supportive, outrageous, honest, and wholesome questions of other Diemers, which span everything from birth control to friendship, sexuality to pop culture, parenting to relationships, money to reproductive health, career to books, and so much more. Diem feels more like searching for answers in the girls’ bathroom than spiraling alone on the internet.

Here’s what you can find in the app today:

Diem AI-powered search

Ask Diem AI, our AI-powered search tool, your questions! Our search engine is designed to be less bias than other models. You can think of Diem AI as your most knowledgeable Virgo “big sister” who lives in your back pocket. Diem AI draws from across the internet and the collective wisdom of Diemers to generate you a speedy answer. When you ask Diem AI you’ll receive a short summary answer, community sources (previous, related conversations in Diem), community spaces, web pages, Reddit threads and TikTok videos. You can dive in to these search results OR you can post your search to the community feed to get real-time feedback from people who’ve been there.

Diem AI Lenses

You can now ask questions of leading experts and your fave creators in Diem. Ask their Lens anything and your search result will feature their opinions & content from across the internet.

Discover thousands of authentic conversations

From awkward sex questions to wholesome big sisterly advice or navigating life’s highs and lows, Diem is full of the collective knowledge of girls, women, and LGBTQIA+ folks in over 100 countries.There’s no judgment here and you’ll feel that very quickly.

Post anonymously or under a pseudonym

We think of the anonymous feature as a confidence booster. Sometimes posting ‘taboo’ questions or personal stories publicly can be nerve-wracking, so this feature is designed to make you feel more comfortable while getting the advice you need.

Community Spaces

Community Spaces are micro communities that are also discoverable when related questions are searched via Diem AI. A few currently live: Am I wrong?, Big Sis Advice (BSA) and Is this Normal…? (ITN) We’re still early in building out Spaces and you can request additional Spaces or host your own.

Creating Posts

If you have a longer story, recommendation or advice to offer you can click the + button on your Discover feed and type out all your stories or wisdom. These posts will be discovered via the search engine and in Diemer’s discovery feeds.

Upvoting & Bookmarking

See a post or response you want to save for later or give some love to, click to bookmark, “heart” or upvote it!

Safety & Privacy First

Safety & moderation are our top priority at Diem. See something, say something! We have distributed moderation—if you report something, we review it, ensuring there’s no violation of the community culture. We also take your privacy very seriously—whatever you search is your business.

We’re still early in our journey to build Diem into your new ‘front door’ to the internet, if you have any problems or ideas for the app, get support at help@askdiem.com.

Happy Dieming!

- Progress Tracking — See what changed when you fixed something.

✨ What Makes Energio Different

Energio is built for one thing: solving chronic tiredness and fatigue. Not steps. Not sleep duration. Not workout recovery for athletes. Just the question millions of people search every night — why am I so tired? — answered with their own data.

- Phone-only. No €300 ring or watch required.
- Diagnostic, not prescriptive — finds the cause, doesn't lecture.
- Built for tired people, not biohackers.
- AI maps patterns across HRV, sleep, lifestyle, and self-reports.
- Action-oriented — every insight comes with a fix to test.

🔍 What Energio Can Help You Spot

- How alcohol the night before drops your HRV the next day
- How late-night screens silently delay your recovery
- How a week without sunlight crashes your energy by Friday
- How stress accumulates before you consciously feel it
- Which lifestyle factors give you energy — and which steal it

👤 Who Energio Is For

People who are tired for no clear reason. Burned-out professionals. Remote workers stuck in afternoon slumps. Students, freelancers, creators running on fumes. Anyone recovering from burnout, post-viral fatigue, or chronic tiredness. Anyone who's tried sleeping more and felt no different.

You're not lazy. You're not broken. You're tired — and there's usually a reason.
Energio finds the why. You get the how.

📲 Download Energio and stop guessing why you feel drained.

name: Allervibe: Food Allergy Scan
description:
Stop guessing in the grocery aisle.

You're standing in front of a shelf, package in hand. The label is in 6-point font. The "may contain" warning is hiding somewhere between the additives and the nutrition table. Your kid has a peanut allergy. You squint. You flip the box. You put it back. You move on.

Allervibe was built for that moment.

Point your camera at the barcode. In about a second, you have your answer: green to eat, yellow for caution, red to avoid. No squinting. No second-guessing. No anxiety in aisle four.

Here is the whole loop:

1. Tell Allervibe once which allergens you avoid, with how strict you are about each.
2. Scan a barcode.
3. We read the ingredients, the allergen declarations, and the trace warnings, then match them against your profile.
4. You get a clear verdict, plus the full ingredient list and a breakdown of every additive used.

That is it. No account. No sync. No waiting.

Allervibe covers the 13 most common food allergens: peanuts, tree nuts, milk, eggs, soy, wheat, gluten, sesame, shellfish, fish, sulphites, mustard, and celery. Behind the scenes we use Open Food Facts, the world's largest open database of food products, with millions of entries from over 100 countries. Coverage in your local supermarket gets better every week.

Built for:

• Parents reading every label twice for their kids
• Anyone with celiac disease, gluten intolerance, or a wheat allergy
• People managing lactose intolerance or dairy sensitivities
• Adults with nut, peanut, sesame, or shellfish allergies
• Households balancing multiple dietary needs in one shopping trip
• Vegans and vegetarians spotting hidden animal ingredients
• Travellers reading labels in foreign supermarkets

Allervibe is free to use, every day. The free version covers daily scans, your personal allergen profile, and full detection across all 13 allergens. No ads. Ever.

Allervibe Pro unlocks:

• Unlimited daily scans
• Your full scan history with search
• Favorites for products you have already cleared
• Family profiles, so each person in the household has their own allergen list
• A detailed additives breakdown with E-numbers and common names

A profile for every member of your family? That was the whole point. One person is celiac. Another is dairy-free. A third reacts to nuts. With family profiles in Allervibe Pro you switch between them with a tap before you scan, and everyone gets the answer that matters to them.

Allervibe lives on your device. Your allergen profiles, your scan history, and your favorites stay private. We do not sell your data. We do not share what you scan. We do not require an account or a sign-in.

Currently available in English and German, with French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, and Russian on the way.

A note on safety. Allervibe is an informational tool, not a medical device. Always read the packaging before you eat. If you have a severe or life-threatening allergy, do not rely on the app alone. Read the label, follow your doctor's guidance, and carry your prescribed medication. Data accuracy depends on Open Food Facts, which is community-edited and may be incomplete.

In short, we're kind of "the Wikipedia of food", as many have nicknamed the project. Open Food Facts has enabled the creation of over 100 apps like Date Limite, Yuka or FoodVisor.

🥦 Make Healthier Food Choices



➜ The Nutri-Score grade, from A to E : Nutritional quality
➜ The NOVA group, from 1 to 4 : Avoid ultra-processed foods (Group 4)

🌍 Join Our Mission for Food Transparency



➜ Open Food Facts is a food products database made by everyone, for everyone.
➜ You can use it to make better food choices, and as it is open data, anyone can re-use it for any purpose.
➜ You can start contributing today by adding a product from your fridge.
➜ Open Food Facts is a non-profit project developed by thousands of volunteers from around the world. We have lots of exciting projects you can contribute to in many different ways.

🏷️ Decode Food Labels with Ease



➜ Open Food Facts helps you decipher products labels. You will be able to find:
➜ carbon footprint (CO2 emissions) and packaging (as well as recycling instructions),
➜ Nutriscore (nutritional score), nutrients, fat / fat content, saturated fatty acids, carbohydrates, sugars, fiber, protein and salt and sodium.
➜ brands, allergens, labels (bio, gluten free, vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher ...), traceability information (packaging codes, origins of ingredients)
➜ On wines and beers, you will find the alcohol content.

🔬 Backed by Science, Supporting Research


➜ We don't make up things. We rely on peer-reviewed science.
➜ The Nutri-Score has been created by the independent French team led by Professor Hercberg.
➜ The NOVA groups on food processing have been designed by the international team of Professor Monteiro.
➜ The additives synthesis is based on reviews by EFSA on exposure levels on food additives.
➜ The Open Food Facts community is collaborating with research teams across the planet to improve nutrition research that benefits all.

🔒 Your food, your data. Privacy-Centric App


➜ Your data is yours, and is never sent online
➜ You can use the app anonymously
➜ You can export your scan history

🚨 Set Allergen Alerts

Über 1.500 Rezepte aus dem Gluten Free Magazin warten auf dich! Die vielfältigen Rezepte aus der Gluten Free Küche sowie von weiteren Glutenfrei-Profis zeigen dir, wie glutenfreies Backen und Kochen einfach gelingt und lecker schmeckt.

Bei den abwechslungsreichen Rezeptideen ist für jeden Geschmack etwas dabei! Die Vielfalt reicht von Brot und Brötchen über bunte Salate, regionale Klassiker und internationale Spezialitäten bis hin zu köstlichen Kuchen und Torten. Viele Rezepte sind vegetarisch oder vegan. Bei Backrezepten kommen mal fertige und mal eigene Mehlmischungen zum Einsatz.

Ob Einsteiger oder ambitionierter Hobby-Koch – die Gluten Free App begeistert alle, die alltagstaugliche, gelingsichere Rezepte suchen. Die detaillierten Anleitungen führen dich Schritt für Schritt durch die Zubereitung. Zu jedem Rezept findest du Zubereitungszeiten und Nährwertangaben sowie hilfreiche Tipps. Ob als Single oder für die ganze Familie: Mit dem Portionenrechner kannst du die Zutaten nach Belieben anpassen.

LASS DICH INSPIRIEREN
Auf der Startseite findest du immer wieder neue Rezeptideen zum Backen und Kochen. Und unser Rezept des Tages bietet dir täglich neue Inspiration. Regelmäßig reinschauen lohnt sich!

GESUCHT, GEFUNDEN!
Du bist auf der Suche nach dem ultimativen Rezept für Pizza oder Zimtschnecken? Oder brauchst du eine Anregung, was du aus dem Kühlschrankinhalt zaubern kannst? Suche nach Stichwörtern oder Zutaten und passe mit dem Suchfilter die Ergebnisse individuell an – lasse dir z. B. nur vegane oder vegetarische Rezepte anzeigen oder schließe Zutaten aus, die du nicht verträgst, wie Ei, Milch oder Hefe. So findest du dein Wunschrezept noch einfacher!

DEINE FAVORITEN ALS KOCHBUCH
Speichere deine Lieblingsrezepte einfach in der App, so hast du dein eigenes Kochbuch immer dabei.

RATGEBER UND ALLTAGSTIPPS
Die Gluten Free App bietet mehr als nur Rezepte: Auf der Startseite findest du immer wieder hilfreiche Artikel rund um den glutenfreien Alltag sowie Hintergrundinfos zu Zöliakie und zur glutenfreien Ernährung.

GLUTEN FREE ALS E-PAPER
Mit dem Gluten Free Plus Abo kannst du alle Ausgaben von Gluten Free als E-Paper lesen. Frischen Lesestoff gibt es alle zwei Monate mit einer neuen Ausgabe des Magazins.

TEST THE BEST
Entdecke und teste die Gluten Free App! Ohne Abo gibt es diese Funktionen kostenfrei für dich:
• Täglich ein neues Rezept des Tages
• 5 Rezepte der immer wieder neuen Rezeptsammlungen auf der Startseite
• Bis zu 5 Favoriten in deinem Kochbuch
• Redaktionelle Beiträge auf der Startseite

GLUTEN FREE PLUS
Du willst das komplette Angebot der Gluten Free App nutzen? Dann profitiere von den Premium-Vorteilen zum kleinen Preis! Mit dem Gluten Free Plus Abo (2,49 € im Monat oder 23,99 € im Jahr) hast du Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und Funktionen:
• Zugang zu allen Rezepten – aktuell über 1.500 (mit jeder neuen Gluten Free kommen weitere dazu)
• Unbegrenzt Lieblingsrezepte in dein Kochbuch speichern
• Alle Ausgaben des Gluten Free Magazins als E-Paper lesen

ÜBER GLUTEN FREE
Im Gluten Free Magazin dreht sich alles rund um die glutenfreie Ernährung. Seit 2017 erscheint das Magazin, inzwischen mit sechs Ausgaben jährlich, in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, in Luxemburg und Südtirol. Seit 2024 gibt es die Rezepte aus dem Gluten Free Magazin auch als App, die wie das Magazin vom frei & fein Verlag herausgegeben wird.

SUPPORT
Du hast eine technische Frage zur App oder ein Problem mit dem Abo? Dann schreibe uns an support@glutenfree-app.de. Wir helfen dir gern weiter!

Viel Spaß beim Kochen und Backen!
Dein Gluten Free Team

name: Eat Smart Kiwi: Food Diary
description:
Track what you eat. Track how you feel. Get insights on what to eat differently.

Eat Smart Kiwi helps you discover the effect of your eating on acne, bloating, stomach pain, headaches, energy levels, mood, or anything else you want to track. Every day, you record what you eat and how you feel, and we figure out all the correlations between the two. This helps you discover your personal allergies or intolerances, or simply how your body reacts to different foods and drinks.

In addition Eat Smart Kiwi lets you track exercise, sleep, weight, bowel movements, and anything else that may be relevant to your health.

After keeping a food and health diary, you'll get insights on what foods make your conditions worse, and what foods make them better, as well as the strength and significance of the correlation, whether others have experienced the same thing, and whether any scientific studies have been done on that particular food and condition. You will also get information on your typical nutrient intake if desired.

Track your energy levels, find which foods tend to reduce your headaches, improve your skin, or help with digestion problems. Use Eat Smart Kiwi to diagnose and discover how what you eat truly affects you.

Eat Smart Kiwi contains a built-in food database to make the entry process as painless as possible. Our analysis is enhanced with data about the cateogries and ingredients of each these foods. Your diary and insights will sync across all devices you are signed in to, including a browser.

Note that a small monthly subscription is required to the view the insights. The diary is free forever.

name: Eating Buddy: Food Diary
description:
Did you know that only 2 in 10 people who diet or count calories manage to keep the weight off? And, at the same time, more than 3 in 10 people end up gaining more weight than before they started.

So chances are, dieting or counting calories will leave you worse off overall.

Eating Buddy offers a different approach

Your body is designed to regulate weight naturally. But highly processed foods, dieting, and chronic stress can override its signals to a point where eating feels out of control.

That’s where Eating Buddy steps in. It helps you return to a more natural, intuitive way of eating through awareness.

How it works

🍏 Log meals and body cues in seconds
Quickly log meals, hunger, and fullness to build awareness.

🌟 Track what affects your eating
Note mood, workouts, sleep, and drinks to see what influences how you eat.

🔖 Reflect and organize
Use notes or tags to add context and categorize meals.

📈 See Patterns over time
Eating Buddy helps surface patterns so connections become easier to notice.

🎯 Choose challenges that fit you
Based on your patterns, pick supportive challenges to focus on one small, meaningful change at a time.

If you are tired of starting over with dieting and want a calmer, more sustainable way to relate to food, download Eating Buddy now to get started.

name: Endive - IBS Food Diary
description:

Food is a common trigger of digestive symptoms. Avoiding certain foods or keeping a low FODMAP diet can dramatically improve issues like gas, bloating, stomach pain, diarrhoea, constipation and others.

However, everyone is different and there is no one-size-fits-all IBS diet: Keeping a diary of what you eat and how you feel is vital to learning what triggers your symptoms.

Take charge of your digestion and gut health.

📉PERSONALISED TRACKER
Add custom foods and symptoms that are personal to you and track them together with the others. Endive knows recipes and breaks them down into ingredients to make IBS tracking faster and more efficient.

If you have a condition you know about, but want to optimise your diet to help improve your symptoms, Endive helps you keep track of what you have eaten and how you feel, both physically and psychologically. This allows you to learn how your body reacts to different foods 🥑, or which triggers (e.g. anxiety, depression) are causing you symptoms.

📊WIDE RANGING TRACKER

Endive helps you manage conditions such as:

✅ IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome)
✅ IBD (Inflammatory Bowel Disease)
✅ Food intolerance and sensitivities (such as Dairy, Wheat/Gluten, Lactose)

name: Food For You: Your Food Diary
description:
Food For You is the easiest way to eat well without spreadsheets, barcode hunts or guesswork. Snap a meal and the AI logs the calories, protein, fat and carbs straight into your diary. Point your camera at a food label and get a health score, allergen flags and a plain-language breakdown of every additive. One app does the diary and the scanner.

YOUR DAILY PLAN, BUILT FOR YOU
Tell the AI your age, weight, activity and goal (lose, maintain or gain). It calculates your daily calorie target and splits it into protein, fat and carbs using the Mifflin-St Jeor formula. Don't agree with a number? Edit any value with a tap.

SNAP A MEAL, LOG THE MACROS
Photograph any plate (homemade, restaurant or packaged) and the AI identifies the dish, estimates the portion and writes calories and macros into your diary. Adjust by hand if you want, or just trust the photo. Your diary fills itself, breakfast through snack.

LABEL SCANNER THAT GOES DEEPER
Point your camera at any food label and get a 0-100 health score built from NOVA and Nutri-Score, an Eco-Score for the planet, a Glycemic Index reading and every additive decoded in plain English. Know what's really in the box before it hits your cart.

ALLERGEN ALERTS, 60+ TRIGGERS
Set your allergy profile once: nuts, gluten, dairy, soy, shellfish and 60+ more. Every scan and diary entry is checked against it. Unsafe ingredients get flagged before you take a bite.

PERSONAL DIET PROFILES
Pick how you eat and the AI factors it into every result:
• Halal (new), vegan, vegetarian
• Keto, paleo, Mediterranean
• Gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free
• Low-sodium, low-sugar, heart-healthy

DAILY PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
A calorie ring, macro bars and a meal-by-meal view show how breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks stack up against your target. Streaks, XP, levels and small daily challenges make it easy to stay consistent.

COMPARE TWO PRODUCTS
Two yogurts? Two cereals? Scan both, see them side by side, pick the one that actually fits your goals.

YOUR HISTORY, ALWAYS YOURS
Search past scans, scroll past diary days and watch the patterns shift over weeks and months.

FREE PLAN
• 3 scans and 3 product compares a day
• Last 10 scans saved
• Last 7 diary days kept

PREMIUM, 7-DAY FREE TRIAL
• Unlimited scans and compares
• Full scan and diary history, kept forever
• AI macro logging on every meal
• Cancel any time

WHY PEOPLE PICK FOOD FOR YOU
• Real AI analysis on every photo, not a static barcode database
• Diary and scanner together: calories, macros, allergens, additives in one place
• Targets calculated from your body and your goal, not a generic preset
• Halal support plus 60+ allergens, useful for families with mixed diets
• 10 languages with full right-to-left Arabic
• Privacy-first. Your data stays yours, never sold
• No ads, ever

Download Food For You and let the AI handle the math while you focus on eating well.
